blocks.en: 31 voices helped shape ReLEAF, connecting our lab work with the needs, concerns, and experience of farmers, experts, and the wider community.
blocks.text: 31 voices helped shape ReLEAF, connecting our lab work with the needs, concerns, and experience of farmers, experts, and the wider community.
blocks.zh: 31 個聲音幫助塑造了 ReLEAF，把我們在實驗室裡的工作，與農友、專家和更廣大社群的需求、顧慮與經驗連結起來。

blocks.en: Over seven months, we returned to stakeholders with updated prototypes, new wet-lab results, and revised designs, using each round of feedback to improve the project. Farmers helped us understand which problems mattered most and what would make the system practical and accessible in the field. Researchers and technical experts guided decisions around bioreactor design, containment, monitoring, and scale-up, while other stakeholders helped us work towards adoption and deployment. These conversations did not sit beside the project; they directly changed how ReLEAF was designed, tested, and developed.
blocks.text: Over seven months, we returned to stakeholders with updated prototypes, new wet-lab results, and revised designs, using each round of feedback to improve the project. Farmers helped us understand which problems mattered most and what would make the system practical and accessible in the field. Researchers and technical experts guided decisions around bioreactor design, containment, monitoring, and scale-up, while other stakeholders helped us work towards adoption and deployment. These conversations did not sit beside the project; they directly changed how ReLEAF was designed, tested, and developed.
blocks.zh: 七個月間，我們帶著更新的原型、新的濕式實驗結果和修改過的設計，一再回到利害關係人面前，用每一輪回饋改進專案。農友讓我們理解哪些問題最重要，以及什麼樣的系統在田間才用得上、拿得到。研究人員與技術專家指引了生物反應器設計、圍阻、監測與放大的決策，其他利害關係人則協助我們推進採用與落地。這些對話並不是擺在專案旁邊的附件；它們直接改變了 ReLEAF 被設計、測試與開發的方式。

blocks.en: Overview
blocks.text: Overview
blocks.zh: 總覽

blocks.en: ReLEAF started with one question from the farmers in Ghana: are abiotic stresses really affecting our crops? This question guided our journey from February to October, shaping the development of our project as we investigated farmers’ challenges, consulted experts, and refined our approach to addressing crop stress.
blocks.text: ReLEAF started with one question from the farmers in Ghana: are abiotic stresses really affecting our crops? This question guided our journey from February to October, shaping the development of our project as we investigated farmers’ challenges, consulted experts, and refined our approach to addressing crop stress.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 起於迦納農友的一個問題：非生物逆境真的在影響我們的作物嗎？這個問題引導了我們從二月到十月的歷程；我們一邊探究農友面對的難題、諮詢專家，一邊修正處理作物逆境的做法，專案也在這個過程中成形。

blocks.en: In our project ReLEAF, Human Practices acts as the heart of the team, connecting the research and work we have done in the lab with the real-world needs that help to shape our project. Rather than developing ReLEAF based only on what is scientifically possible, Human Practices allows us to consider how our project could fit into the agricultural world and how it may affect the people who would be interacting with it.
blocks.text: In our project ReLEAF, Human Practices acts as the heart of the team, connecting the research and work we have done in the lab with the real-world needs that help to shape our project. Rather than developing ReLEAF based only on what is scientifically possible, Human Practices allows us to consider how our project could fit into the agricultural world and how it may affect the people who would be interacting with it.
blocks.zh: 在 ReLEAF 這個專案裡，人類實踐是團隊的核心，把我們在實驗室完成的研究與工作，和塑造專案的真實需求連起來。我們不只依據科學上做得到什麼來發展 ReLEAF；人類實踐讓我們得以思考這個專案如何融入農業現場，以及它可能如何影響那些會與它互動的人。

blocks.en: Sitting at the center of various topics such as synthetic biology, climate change, agriculture, and biotechnology, ReLEAF has reached out to a plethora of different stakeholders, including farmers, researchers, professors, agricultural organizations, companies, and members of the public. We deeply value every interaction, hoping to truly be able to gain and understand the different perspectives of differing groups of people, and to identify gaps, challenge our assumptions, and improve our project.
blocks.text: Sitting at the center of various topics such as synthetic biology, climate change, agriculture, and biotechnology, ReLEAF has reached out to a plethora of different stakeholders, including farmers, researchers, professors, agricultural organizations, companies, and members of the public. We deeply value every interaction, hoping to truly be able to gain and understand the different perspectives of differing groups of people, and to identify gaps, challenge our assumptions, and improve our project.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 座落在合成生物學、氣候變遷、農業與生物科技等多個議題的交會處，因此接觸了非常多元的利害關係人，包括農友、研究人員、教授、農業組織、企業與一般民眾。我們珍視每一次互動，希望真正取得並理解不同群體的觀點，藉此找出缺口、挑戰自己的假設，並改進專案。

blocks.en: This page is organized into four main sections. The Project Evolution Map provides an overview of how ReLEAF developed over time and highlights the key moments and stakeholder insights that significantly influenced our project. Expert Engagement documents our conversations and collaborations with experts from different fields, organized into individual pipelines based on their areas of expertise and the topics we discussed, as well as our continuous engagement. Farmer Engagement focuses on our conversations with farmers, the primary beneficiaries of our project, and the insights we gained from understanding their experiences and needs. Finally, Public Engagement presents our efforts to communicate with and learn from the wider public. Together, these sections trace how our interactions with different stakeholders continuously shaped and refined ReLEAF.

blocks.zh: 本頁分為四個主要部分。專案演進地圖概覽 ReLEAF 隨時間發展的過程，標出深刻影響專案的關鍵時刻與利害關係人見解。專家互動記錄我們與不同領域專家的對談和合作，依他們的專業領域與我們討論的主題分成數條脈絡，並包含持續互動的部分。農友互動聚焦我們與農友的對話，農友是專案的主要受益者；這一節也記錄我們理解他們的經驗與需求後得到的見解。最後，公眾互動呈現我們與更廣大公眾溝通、並向他們學習的努力。這幾個部分合起來，追溯我們與不同利害關係人的互動如何持續塑造並精修 ReLEAF。

blocks.en: We began by defining the biological problem and testing our original concept. Feedback from experts helped us narrow our focus from applying a broad PGPR (plant growth-promoting rhizobacteria) system aimed at many stresses to one concept we could test.
blocks.text: We began by defining the biological problem and testing our original concept. Feedback from experts helped us narrow our focus from applying a broad PGPR (plant growth-promoting rhizobacteria) system aimed at many stresses to one concept we could test.
blocks.zh: 我們先定義生物學上的問題，並測試最初的構想。專家的回饋協助我們把焦點從一套針對多種逆境的廣泛 PGPR（植物生長促進根圈細菌）系統，收斂到一個我們測得起來的概念。

blocks.en: In the final stage, we connected our development to real-world application. We focused on system reliability, farmer usability, regulation, and whether our experiments clearly demonstrated our proposed mechanism. Feedback from agricultural forums and experts helped us identify the evidence needed to assess the system’s practicality and value to farmers.
blocks.text: In the final stage, we connected our development to real-world application. We focused on system reliability, farmer usability, regulation, and whether our experiments clearly demonstrated our proposed mechanism. Feedback from agricultural forums and experts helped us identify the evidence needed to assess the system’s practicality and value to farmers.
blocks.zh: 最後階段，我們把開發工作接回真實應用。我們關注系統可靠性、農友的使用性、法規，以及我們的實驗是否清楚展示了我們提出的機制。農業論壇與專家的回饋協助我們釐清：要評估這套系統對農友的實用性與價值，需要哪些證據。

blocks.en: Throughout the meeting with Prof. Cheng, we introduced our proposed engineered Bacillus subtilis system for detecting plant and environmental stress and responding by producing protective compounds such as trehalose or ACC deaminase. She agreed with our ideas of choosing abiotic stresses such as heat, salinity, and drought, and choosing Arabidopsis as a suitable model for controlled experiments. Additionally, she noted that hydroponics might not be stable for our testing and suggested that we should not rely solely on it. Her expertise provided valuable guidance and helped shape and refine the direction of our project.
blocks.text: Throughout the meeting with Prof. Cheng, we introduced our proposed engineered Bacillus subtilis system for detecting plant and environmental stress and responding by producing protective compounds such as trehalose or ACC deaminase. She agreed with our ideas of choosing abiotic stresses such as heat, salinity, and drought, and choosing Arabidopsis as a suitable model for controlled experiments. Additionally, she noted that hydroponics might not be stable for our testing and suggested that we should not rely solely on it. Her expertise provided valuable guidance and helped shape and refine the direction of our project.
blocks.zh: 在與 Prof. Cheng 的會談中，我們介紹了我們提出的工程化 Bacillus subtilis 系統：偵測植物與環境逆境，並以產生海藻糖或 ACC 去胺酶等保護化合物作為回應。她同意我們選擇熱、鹽度、乾旱等非生物逆境，也同意以 Arabidopsis 作為控制實驗的合適模式。此外，她指出水耕對我們的測試可能不夠穩定，建議不要只依賴水耕。她的專業給了我們寶貴的指引，協助塑造並修正專案的方向。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: Her feedback made us realize that experimental procedures themselves can interfere with plant stress responses. More importantly, the feedback led us to a shift toward more realistic and controllable plant-growth conditions. She suggested that the project should prioritize agar plate growth for early-stage control, followed by careful transfer to soil. We should carefully manage environmental transitions and stress timing, and use visual ROS staining to improve stress assessment. We also decided to remove osmotic stress from our targeted stresses. Additionally, Prof. Cheng kindly provided us with Arabidopsis seeds and shared valuable guidance on their cultivation and optimal growing conditions.
blocks.text: Her feedback made us realize that experimental procedures themselves can interfere with plant stress responses. More importantly, the feedback led us to a shift toward more realistic and controllable plant-growth conditions. She suggested that the project should prioritize agar plate growth for early-stage control, followed by careful transfer to soil. We should carefully manage environmental transitions and stress timing, and use visual ROS staining to improve stress assessment. We also decided to remove osmotic stress from our targeted stresses. Additionally, Prof. Cheng kindly provided us with Arabidopsis seeds and shared valuable guidance on their cultivation and optimal growing conditions.
blocks.zh: 她的回饋讓我們意識到，實驗流程本身就可能干擾植物的逆境反應。更重要的是，這些回饋讓我們轉向更貼近真實、也更可控的植物生長條件。她建議專案前期以瓊脂培養盤栽培為主，便於控制，之後再小心移到土壤。我們應該謹慎處理環境轉換與加逆境的時機，並用可目視的 ROS 染色改善逆境評估。我們也決定把滲透逆境從目標逆境中移除。此外，Prof. Cheng 慷慨提供我們 Arabidopsis 種子，並分享栽培方式與最適生長條件的寶貴指引。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation

blocks.en: After the meeting, we had a very meaningful takeaway on the idea of optimizing proline dosage and investigating whether bacterial products affect the plant’s natural proline-redox cycle. He also inspired us to consider testing stress priming approaches and measuring indicators such as root growth and biomass. Additionally, he mentioned that we should adjust our system to prioritize early stress detection rather than stress recovery. More details in Plants wiki.
blocks.text: After the meeting, we had a very meaningful takeaway on the idea of optimizing proline dosage and investigating whether bacterial products affect the plant’s natural proline-redox cycle. He also inspired us to consider testing stress priming approaches and measuring indicators such as root growth and biomass. Additionally, he mentioned that we should adjust our system to prioritize early stress detection rather than stress recovery. More details in Plants wiki.
blocks.zh: 會後我們得到一個很有意義的收穫：優化脯胺酸劑量，並探究細菌產物是否影響植物本身的脯胺酸–氧化還原循環。他也啟發我們考慮測試逆境預馴（stress priming）的做法，並測量根生長與生物量等指標。此外，他提到我們應該調整系統，把早期逆境偵測放在逆境復原之前。更多細節見植物頁面。

blocks.en: Engineered Bacillus subtilis (PGPR) detects environmental stresses (drought, salinity, heat, and osmotic stress) and responds by producing plant-protective compounds such as trehalose and ACC deaminase.
blocks.text: Engineered Bacillus subtilis (PGPR) detects environmental stresses (drought, salinity, heat, and osmotic stress) and responds by producing plant-protective compounds such as trehalose and ACC deaminase.
blocks.zh: 工程化 Bacillus subtilis（PGPR）偵測環境逆境（乾旱、鹽度、熱與滲透逆境），並以產生海藻糖、ACC 去胺酶等植物保護化合物作為回應。

blocks.en: Signal molecules (e.g., naringenin and salicylic acid) activate survival genes, improving the bacteria’s ability to persist and function under stressful conditions.
blocks.text: Signal molecules (e.g., naringenin and salicylic acid) activate survival genes, improving the bacteria’s ability to persist and function under stressful conditions.

blocks.en: Professor Huang, Chieh-Chen is currently working in the Department of Life Sciences at National Chung Hsing University. He specializes in Synthetic biology, Microbial carbon fixation development, Plant endophytes, Environmental biotechnology, Bioenergy technology, and microbiology.

blocks.en: Event summary
blocks.text: Event summary
blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: We consulted with Prof. Huang to evaluate the timing, dosage, sensing strategy, and application of our protectant-delivery system. During the discussion, he highlighted that biostimulants can be most effective when applied during the seedling stage to have effects that last longer, which also helps adjust gene regulation signals as cells replicate for long-term protection. Prof. Huang also mentioned that excessive stress or protectant concentrations may affect plant health negatively, so it is important to set appropriate thresholds and validate dosages. From an agricultural angle, hydroponic systems may not completely simulate field conditions, and farmers often prioritize simple application. Therefore, our system should integrate functions such as environmental sensing and weather forecasting to predict stress while keeping it easy for farmers to operate. Prof. Huang also kindly provided us with the B. subtilis WB800 strain, which we further used in other experiments.
blocks.text: We consulted with Prof. Huang to evaluate the timing, dosage, sensing strategy, and application of our protectant-delivery system. During the discussion, he highlighted that biostimulants can be most effective when applied during the seedling stage to have effects that last longer, which also helps adjust gene regulation signals as cells replicate for long-term protection. Prof. Huang also mentioned that excessive stress or protectant concentrations may affect plant health negatively, so it is important to set appropriate thresholds and validate dosages. From an agricultural angle, hydroponic systems may not completely simulate field conditions, and farmers often prioritize simple application. Therefore, our system should integrate functions such as environmental sensing and weather forecasting to predict stress while keeping it easy for farmers to operate. Prof. Huang also kindly provided us with the B. subtilis WB800 strain, which we further used in other experiments.
blocks.zh: 我們諮詢 Prof. Huang，評估保護劑輸送系統的時機、劑量、感測策略與施用方式。討論中他指出，生物刺激素在苗期施用效果可能最好，作用也維持得比較久；這同時有助於隨著細胞複製調整基因調控訊號，形成長期保護。Prof. Huang 也提到，逆境或保護劑濃度過高可能對植物健康造成負面影響，因此設定合適的閾值並驗證劑量很重要。從農業角度看，水耕系統可能無法完全模擬田間條件，而農友通常最在意施用是否簡單。因此我們的系統應該整合環境感測與天氣預報等功能來預測逆境，同時維持農友容易操作。Prof. Huang 也慷慨提供我們 B. subtilis WB800 菌株，我們後續在其他實驗中使用。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: This meeting changed our understanding of when and how our bioreactor should respond to stress. We also learned that different protectants may require different amounts of time, some can prime plants before stress, and others may be more effective when stress occurs. This led us to consider periodic rather than continuous operation and seedling-stage application as alternative strategies.
blocks.text: This meeting changed our understanding of when and how our bioreactor should respond to stress. We also learned that different protectants may require different amounts of time, some can prime plants before stress, and others may be more effective when stress occurs. This led us to consider periodic rather than continuous operation and seedling-stage application as alternative strategies.
blocks.zh: 這次會談改變了我們對生物反應器該在何時、以什麼方式回應逆境的理解。我們也了解到不同保護劑需要的時間不同：有些可以在逆境來臨前先讓植物預馴，有些則在逆境發生時更有效。這讓我們把週期性運轉（而非連續運轉）與苗期施用列為替代策略來考慮。

blocks.en: After the last meeting with Prof. Huang, we visited him at NCHU in person to gain some feedback on our project direction. For wetlab, the discussion focused on improving protein expression and secretion. For the plant model, he advised establishing a clear experimental rationale for salinity and heat stress across agar, hydroponic, and soil systems. For drylab, the focus shifted toward designing shorter or modified peptide constructs while retaining biological activity, and using receptor–peptide interactions to guide construct selection.
blocks.text: After the last meeting with Prof. Huang, we visited him at NCHU in person to gain some feedback on our project direction. For wetlab, the discussion focused on improving protein expression and secretion. For the plant model, he advised establishing a clear experimental rationale for salinity and heat stress across agar, hydroponic, and soil systems. For drylab, the focus shifted toward designing shorter or modified peptide constructs while retaining biological activity, and using receptor–peptide interactions to guide construct selection.
blocks.zh: 上一次會談之後，我們親自到中興大學拜訪 Prof. Huang，取得對專案方向的回饋。濕式實驗方面，討論聚焦在提升蛋白質表現與分泌。植物模式方面，他建議為瓊脂、水耕與土壤三種系統中的鹽逆境與熱逆境建立清楚的實驗依據。乾式實驗方面，重點轉向設計較短或經修改的胜肽構築，同時保留生物活性，並以受體–胜肽的交互作用來指引構築的選擇。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: The consultation helped us improve our understanding of protein and plant models. We recognized that only improving secretion is insufficient if the resulting protein does not retain its activity, so protein quantity, identity, solubility, and function need to be evaluated together.
blocks.text: The consultation helped us improve our understanding of protein and plant models. We recognized that only improving secretion is insufficient if the resulting protein does not retain its activity, so protein quantity, identity, solubility, and function need to be evaluated together.
blocks.zh: 這次諮詢讓我們對蛋白質與植物模式的理解更進一步。我們認知到，如果產出的蛋白質沒有保留活性，單純提升分泌量是不夠的，因此蛋白質的量、身分、溶解度與功能必須一起評估。

blocks.en: Even after considering application methods, we still need to determine when and how much protectant should be delivered. During the interview with Prof. Huang, we asked questions to refine the biological timing, dosage, and sensing strategy. After the meeting, his insights helped us shift toward a more adaptive system that considers seedling stage, stress prediction, dosage thresholds, and periodic rather than continuous operation.
blocks.text: Even after considering application methods, we still need to determine when and how much protectant should be delivered. During the interview with Prof. Huang, we asked questions to refine the biological timing, dosage, and sensing strategy. After the meeting, his insights helped us shift toward a more adaptive system that considers seedling stage, stress prediction, dosage thresholds, and periodic rather than continuous operation.
blocks.zh: 即使考慮過施用方式，我們仍需確定保護劑該在什麼時候送出、送出多少。訪談 Prof. Huang 時，我們提出問題來細化生物上的時機、劑量與感測策略。會後，他的見解讓我們轉向一套更能調適的系統，把苗期、逆境預測、劑量閾值，以及週期性而非連續的運轉都納入考量。

blocks.en: On August 6, we also visited Prof. Huang, who is also from NCHU, to evaluate our B. subtilis engineering strategy, protectant delivery methods, plant testing systems, and potential agricultural applications. We discussed optimizing bacterial production, determining protectant concentration and application timing, and selecting suitable delivery methods such as irrigation, spraying, and seed coating. blocks.text: On August 6, we also visited Prof. Huang, who is also from NCHU, to evaluate our B. subtilis engineering strategy, protectant delivery methods, plant testing systems, and potential agricultural applications. We discussed optimizing bacterial production, determining protectant concentration and application timing, and selecting suitable delivery methods such as irrigation, spraying, and seed coating. blocks.zh: 8月6日，我們也拜訪了同在中興大學的 Prof. Huang，評估我們的 B. subtilis 工程策略、保護劑輸送方式、植物測試系統與可能的農業應用。我們討論了優化細菌產出、決定保護劑濃度與施用時機，以及挑選合適的輸送方式，例如灌溉、噴施與種子包衣。由於我們的細菌會被圍阻在生物反應器內，有效的保護劑輸送對植物的反應相當重要。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation

blocks.en: This interview helped us better understand that our system effectiveness doesn’t only depend on whether B. subtilis produces protectants, but also on how much protectant reaches the plant, when it is delivered, and how frequently it is applied. We also learned that optimizing the culture medium may help reduce metabolic trade-offs while supporting bacterial growth and protein production. More experiments testing protectant effectiveness are on the Results page.
blocks.text: This interview helped us better understand that our system effectiveness doesn’t only depend on whether B. subtilis produces protectants, but also on how much protectant reaches the plant, when it is delivered, and how frequently it is applied. We also learned that optimizing the culture medium may help reduce metabolic trade-offs while supporting bacterial growth and protein production. More experiments testing protectant effectiveness are on the Results page.
blocks.zh: 這次訪談讓我們更清楚：系統的成效不只取決於 B. subtilis 是否產生保護劑，也取決於有多少保護劑到達植物、什麼時候送到，以及施用得多頻繁。我們也了解到，優化培養基可能有助於降低代謝上的取捨，同時支持細菌生長與蛋白質產出。更多測試保護劑效果的實驗見成果頁面。

blocks.en: On the same day we interviewed Prof. Huang, Chieh-Chen, we also interviewed Prof. Huang, Tzu-Pi, who explained to us how we can connect bacterial production, protein function, plant models, and delivery into one system. From this interview, we learned that we need to evaluate quantity, identity, solubility, and biological activity together.

blocks.zh: Yes Health iFarm 以堆疊式垂直水耕系統在室內栽培葉菜、香草與微型蔬菜。因此，藉著他們的專業，我們得到關於高度受控的水耕系統如何管理植物生長的寶貴見解。

blocks.en: Event summary
blocks.text: Event summary
blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: The visit to Yes Health iFarm helped us understand how a highly controlled hydroponic system manages plant growth through environmental monitoring, nutrient management, lighting, aeration, and water circulation. Although we were unable to obtain some of the exact technical data we needed, the discussion provided important design insights for ReLEAF.
blocks.text: The visit to Yes Health iFarm helped us understand how a highly controlled hydroponic system manages plant growth through environmental monitoring, nutrient management, lighting, aeration, and water circulation. Although we were unable to obtain some of the exact technical data we needed, the discussion provided important design insights for ReLEAF.
blocks.zh: 參訪 Yes Health iFarm 讓我們了解高度受控的水耕系統如何透過環境監測、養分管理、照明、曝氣與水循環來管理植物生長。雖然我們沒能取得部分需要的確切技術數據，這次討論仍為 ReLEAF 提供了重要的設計見解。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: After consulting with the expert from Yes Health iFarm, we gained some valuable insights. The discussion led us to reconsider our experimental conditions, improve the integration of environmental sensors, and design ReLEAF to be adaptable to different crops and growing environments.
blocks.text: After consulting with the expert from Yes Health iFarm, we gained some valuable insights. The discussion led us to reconsider our experimental conditions, improve the integration of environmental sensors, and design ReLEAF to be adaptable to different crops and growing environments.
blocks.zh: 諮詢 Yes Health iFarm 的專家後，我們得到一些寶貴的見解。這次討論讓我們重新思考實驗條件、改善環境感測器的整合，並把 ReLEAF 設計成能適應不同作物與栽培環境。

blocks.en: After
blocks.text: After
blocks.zh: 之後

blocks.en: We may expand ReLEAF from simply detecting environmental stress to eventually detecting nutrient deficiencies and automatically supplying the nutrients plants need.
blocks.text: We may expand ReLEAF from simply detecting environmental stress to eventually detecting nutrient deficiencies and automatically supplying the nutrients plants need.
blocks.zh: 我們可能把 ReLEAF 從單純偵測環境逆境，擴展到最終也能偵測養分不足，並自動補給植物需要的養分。

blocks.en: We also want to shift our project philosophy toward treating plants more like living organisms with individual needs, rather than focusing purely on maximizing economic output.
blocks.text: We also want to shift our project philosophy toward treating plants more like living organisms with individual needs, rather than focusing purely on maximizing economic output.
blocks.zh: 我們也希望把專案的理念轉向：把植物更當成有個別需求的生命體看待，而不是只追求經濟產出的最大化。

blocks.en: This could create a stronger connection between plant health, food quality, sustainability, and farmer needs.
blocks.text: This could create a stronger connection between plant health, food quality, sustainability, and farmer needs.
blocks.zh: 這可以讓植物健康、食品品質、永續性與農友需求之間的連結更緊密。

blocks.en: Reconsider our current 8/16 light cycle and investigate whether a 12/12 cycle would produce more natural and reliable growth conditions.
blocks.text: Reconsider our current 8/16 light cycle and investigate whether a 12/12 cycle would produce more natural and reliable growth conditions.
blocks.zh: 重新檢視目前的 8/16 光照週期，並探究 12/12 週期是否能帶來更自然、更可靠的生長條件。

blocks.en: Incorporate DO, and possibly OD into our system parameter planning. (Refer to Plants page)
blocks.text: Incorporate DO, and possibly OD into our system parameter planning. (Refer to Plants page)
blocks.zh: 把 DO、可能還有 OD 納入系統參數規劃。（參見植物頁面）

blocks.en: Further investigate how sensor data can distinguish between different types of plant stress.
blocks.text: Further investigate how sensor data can distinguish between different types of plant stress.
blocks.zh: 進一步探究感測器數據如何區分不同類型的植物逆境。

blocks.en: Modify our growth chamber to provide continuous circulation and gentle aeration rather than relying on pure oxygen. (Refer to Plants page)
blocks.text: Modify our growth chamber to provide continuous circulation and gentle aeration rather than relying on pure oxygen. (Refer to Plants page)
blocks.zh: 改造生長箱，提供連續循環與和緩的曝氣，而不是依賴純氧。（參見植物頁面）

blocks.en: Minimize plant transfers during experiments because transplantation itself can induce stress.
blocks.text: Minimize plant transfers during experiments because transplantation itself can induce stress.
blocks.zh: 減少實驗期間移動植物的次數，因為移植本身就會造成逆境。

blocks.en: Consider plant-specific nutrient concentrations. (Refer to Plants page)
blocks.text: Consider plant-specific nutrient concentrations. (Refer to Plants page)
blocks.zh: 考慮依植物調整養分濃度。（參見植物頁面）

blocks.en: Although our experiments were becoming more technically controlled, we still need to confirm whether those conditions actually reflected a real agricultural growing environment. From the visit to Yes Health iFarm, they encouraged us to make our system more adaptable to different crops and growing environments, improve environmental sensing, and reconsider whether the system should eventually respond to other plant needs such as nutrient deficiencies.
blocks.text: Although our experiments were becoming more technically controlled, we still need to confirm whether those conditions actually reflected a real agricultural growing environment. From the visit to Yes Health iFarm, they encouraged us to make our system more adaptable to different crops and growing environments, improve environmental sensing, and reconsider whether the system should eventually respond to other plant needs such as nutrient deficiencies.
blocks.zh: 雖然我們的實驗在技術上越來越受控，我們仍須確認這些條件是否真的反映真實的農業栽培環境。參訪 Yes Health iFarm 後，他們鼓勵我們讓系統更能適應不同作物與栽培環境、改善環境感測，並重新思考系統最終是否也該回應養分不足等其他植物需求。

blocks.en: However, as we incorporated feedback from different experts, we realized that some of our experimental results might have been influenced by unintentional stress.
blocks.text: However, as we incorporated feedback from different experts, we realized that some of our experimental results might have been influenced by unintentional stress.
blocks.zh: 不過，在納入不同專家的回饋時，我們意識到有些實驗結果可能受到非預期逆境的影響。

blocks.zh: 第二次拜訪 Prof. Cheng 的實驗室時，我們主要就水耕的圍阻問題、瓊脂鹽逆境處理流程、土壤鹽逆境實驗與水耕植物生長的優化向她請益，也討論了我們當時的實驗做法。我們向她報告專案進度與設計，並展示了依她第一次回饋所做的修改。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation

blocks.en: From Prof. Cheng’s feedback, we learned that experimental conditions can strongly influence plant growth and stress responses, so some of our previous results may have been affected by unintended stress rather than the treatments themselves. She also helped us improve the reliability of our plant functional assays by controlling plant age, environmental conditions, root growth, water exposure, and treatment procedures across agar, soil, and hydroponic systems.
blocks.text: From Prof. Cheng’s feedback, we learned that experimental conditions can strongly influence plant growth and stress responses, so some of our previous results may have been affected by unintended stress rather than the treatments themselves. She also helped us improve the reliability of our plant functional assays by controlling plant age, environmental conditions, root growth, water exposure, and treatment procedures across agar, soil, and hydroponic systems.
blocks.zh: 從 Prof. Cheng 的回饋，我們學到實驗條件會強烈影響植物生長與逆境反應，因此我們先前的一些結果可能是受到非預期逆境的影響，而不是處理本身造成的。她也協助我們提升植物功能檢測的可靠性：在瓊脂、土壤與水耕三種系統中控制植物年齡、環境條件、根生長、接水情況與處理流程。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.text: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 結論

blocks.en: Through these consultations, we shifted our project to a more controlled approach. We refined our target plant, stress condition, cultivation, and evaluation strategy, while moving toward supporting the plant’s natural responses rather than simply supplying protection.
blocks.text: Through these consultations, we shifted our project to a more controlled approach. We refined our target plant, stress condition, cultivation, and evaluation strategy, while moving toward supporting the plant’s natural responses rather than simply supplying protection.
blocks.zh: 透過這些諮詢，我們把專案轉向更受控的做法。我們修整了目標植物、逆境條件、栽培方式與評估策略，同時轉向支持植物本身的反應，而不是單純提供保護。

blocks.en: Protectant design
blocks.text: Protectant design
blocks.zh: 保護劑設計

blocks.en: Our Protectant Design pipeline served as the core functional layer of our project, ensuring that our system delivered the types of protectants that were truly helpful to the kind of stress the plants were facing and also actual, measurable stress relief to crops. This pipeline determined which protective molecules we should produce, how they function at a biological level, and how they can be effectively delivered to plants under varying types and levels of stress. By consulting experts across stress biology, biochemistry, and biostimulants, we aligned our selection and testing protocols with real-world application needs, turning our concepts into a practical framework for plant resilience against climate change.

This pipeline determined which protective molecules we should produce, how they function at a biological level, and how they can be effectively delivered to plants under varying types and levels of stress. By consulting experts across stress biology, biochemistry, and biostimulants, we aligned our selection and testing protocols with real-world application needs, turning our concepts into a practical framework for plant resilience against climate change.
blocks.zh: 保護劑設計這條脈絡是專案的核心功能層，確保系統送出的保護劑種類，真的對植物當下面對的逆境有幫助，也真的能為作物帶來可測量的逆境緩解。這條脈絡決定我們應該產生哪些保護分子、它們在生物層級如何作用，以及在不同類型與不同強度的逆境下如何有效送到植物身上。透過諮詢逆境生物學、生物化學與生物刺激素領域的專家，我們讓挑選與測試流程對準真實應用的需求，把概念變成一套讓植物對抗氣候變遷的實用架構。

blocks.en: Our project initially relied on engineered Bacillus subtilis to directly produce and release protective compounds like proline and trehalose to aid plants during drought stress. However, we grew concerned that supplying external proline might suppress the plant's natural proline biosynthesis genes (such as P5CS1) or disrupt its internal proline-redox balance, leading us to consult Dr. Verslues at Academia Sinica.
blocks.text: Our project initially relied on engineered Bacillus subtilis to directly produce and release protective compounds like proline and trehalose to aid plants during drought stress. However, we grew concerned that supplying external proline might suppress the plant's natural proline biosynthesis genes (such as P5CS1) or disrupt its internal proline-redox balance, leading us to consult Dr. Verslues at Academia Sinica.
blocks.zh: 專案一開始靠工程化的 Bacillus subtilis 直接產生並釋放脯胺酸、海藻糖等保護化合物，在乾旱逆境時協助植物。不過我們逐漸擔心，從外部供應脯胺酸可能抑制植物本身的脯胺酸生合成基因（例如 P5CS1），或打亂其內部的脯胺酸–氧化還原平衡，於是我們請益中央研究院的 Dr. Verslues。

blocks.en: Dr. Paul Verslues is part of Academia Sinica and specializes in drought stress, arabidopsis research, and plant stress signaling. His expertise in plant stress helped us shift our emphasis toward early stress detection and preventive protection rather than recovery after damage. He consulted us on the mechanisms of drought and the proline delivery system.

blocks.en: During our meeting with Dr. Verslues, we gained valuable insights into the bacterial aspects of our project. More specifically, he consulted us on the mechanisms of drought and the proline delivery system.
blocks.text: During our meeting with Dr. Verslues, we gained valuable insights into the bacterial aspects of our project. More specifically, he consulted us on the mechanisms of drought and the proline delivery system.
blocks.zh: 在與 Dr. Verslues 的會談中，我們對專案的細菌面向有了寶貴的認識。更具體地說，他為我們解說了乾旱的機制與脯胺酸輸送系統。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation

blocks.en: After the meeting, we had a very meaningful takeaway on the idea of optimizing proline dosage and investigating whether bacterial products affect the plant’s natural proline-redox cycle. He also inspired us to consider testing stress priming approaches and measuring indicators such as root growth and biomass. Additionally, he mentioned that we should adjust our system to prioritize early stress detection rather than stress recovery. More details in Plants wiki.
blocks.text: After the meeting, we had a very meaningful takeaway on the idea of optimizing proline dosage and investigating whether bacterial products affect the plant’s natural proline-redox cycle. He also inspired us to consider testing stress priming approaches and measuring indicators such as root growth and biomass. Additionally, he mentioned that we should adjust our system to prioritize early stress detection rather than stress recovery. More details in Plants wiki.
blocks.zh: 會後我們得到一個很有意義的收穫：優化脯胺酸劑量，並探究細菌產物是否影響植物本身的脯胺酸–氧化還原循環。他也啟發我們考慮測試逆境預馴（stress priming）的做法，並測量根生長與生物量等指標。此外，他提到我們應該調整系統，把早期逆境偵測放在逆境復原之前。更多細節見植物頁面。

blocks.en: Engineered Bacillus subtilis (PGPR) detects environmental stresses (drought, salinity, heat, and osmotic stress) and responds by producing plant-protective compounds such as trehalose and ACC deaminase.
blocks.text: Engineered Bacillus subtilis (PGPR) detects environmental stresses (drought, salinity, heat, and osmotic stress) and responds by producing plant-protective compounds such as trehalose and ACC deaminase.
blocks.zh: 工程化 Bacillus subtilis（PGPR）偵測環境逆境（乾旱、鹽度、熱與滲透逆境），並以產生海藻糖、ACC 去胺酶等植物保護化合物作為回應。

blocks.en: Signal molecules (e.g., naringenin and salicylic acid) activate survival genes, improving the bacteria’s ability to persist and function under stressful conditions.
blocks.text: Signal molecules (e.g., naringenin and salicylic acid) activate survival genes, improving the bacteria’s ability to persist and function under stressful conditions.
blocks.zh: 訊號分子（例如柚皮素與水楊酸）會活化存活基因，提升細菌在逆境條件下續存與運作的能力。

blocks.en: The system enhances plant stress tolerance without genetically modifying the crop, using engineered beneficial bacteria to support plant growth and resilience.
blocks.text: The system enhances plant stress tolerance without genetically modifying the crop, using engineered beneficial bacteria to support plant growth and resilience.
blocks.zh: 這套系統不需對作物進行基因改造就能提升植物的耐逆境能力，而是用工程化的益生菌支持植物生長與韌性。

blocks.en: After
blocks.text: After

blocks.en: Explore a shift from a proline-delivery system toward a plant-regulation system, using bacterial signals or precursors to enhance the plant’s natural drought response
blocks.text: Explore a shift from a proline-delivery system toward a plant-regulation system, using bacterial signals or precursors to enhance the plant’s natural drought response
blocks.zh: 探討從脯胺酸輸送系統轉向植物調控系統，以細菌訊號或前驅物強化植物本身的乾旱反應

blocks.en: Consider testing stress priming approaches and measuring indicators such as root growth and biomass

blocks.zh: 考慮測試逆境預馴的做法，並測量根生長與生物量等指標

blocks.en: During our consultation, Dr. Verslues explained that supplying pure proline directly is inefficient and carries risks of harmful metabolic buildup. He advised us to work with the plant's natural response by shifting to a plant-regulation framework that uses bacterial signals, precursors, or mild stress priming to activate endogenous defense pathways. Following his feedback, we pivoted to an early stress detection approach, testing precursor molecules and focusing our validation on root growth and biomass in soil and agar systems.
blocks.text: During our consultation, Dr. Verslues explained that supplying pure proline directly is inefficient and carries risks of harmful metabolic buildup. He advised us to work with the plant's natural response by shifting to a plant-regulation framework that uses bacterial signals, precursors, or mild stress priming to activate endogenous defense pathways. Following his feedback, we pivoted to an early stress detection approach, testing precursor molecules and focusing our validation on root growth and biomass in soil and agar systems.
blocks.zh: 諮詢時，Dr. Verslues 說明直接供應純脯胺酸效率不高，而且有造成有害代謝物累積的風險。他建議我們順著植物本身的反應來做：改為植物調控的架構，用細菌訊號、前驅物或輕度的逆境預馴來活化植物內源的防禦途徑。依他的回饋，我們轉向早期逆境偵測的做法，測試前驅分子，並把驗證重點放在土壤與瓊脂系統中的根生長與生物量。

blocks.en: When evaluating protectant choices like LEA14, NHP, and BoPEP4, we realized our proof-of-concept strategy was too broad by trying to tackle multiple environmental stresses simultaneously without verifying individual molecule performance. We sought out Dr. Sattely to review our protectant selection, bioavailability, and plant delivery mechanisms.

blocks.zh: 在評估 LEA14、NHP、BoPEP4 等保護劑選項時，我們發現自己的概念驗證策略太廣：想同時處理多種環境逆境，卻沒有先確認單一分子的表現。於是我們找上 Dr. Sattely，請她檢視我們的保護劑選擇、生物可用性與植物輸送機制。

blocks.text: We consulted with Dr. Sattely to evaluate our protectant selection, delivery strategy, and overall project direction. She also emphasized that we should outline more clearly the goals, intentions, and milestones for our project so that it can be more organized, which helped us remember and more deeply consider the focuses and aims of our project.
blocks.zh: 我們諮詢 Dr. Sattely，評估保護劑選擇、輸送策略與整體專案方向。她也強調我們應該把專案的目標、意圖與里程碑寫得更清楚，讓專案更有條理；這讓我們重新記起並更深入思考專案的重點與目的。

blocks.en: She pointed out that our current proof of concept might not be very successful and emphasized the need to clearly define the goals of our project and explain why the proposed solution is important. She suggested we only focus on one type of stress and do it very well instead of surface level for many different stresses and also advised us to explore other types of molecules such as peptides for our project.
blocks.text: She pointed out that our current proof of concept might not be very successful and emphasized the need to clearly define the goals of our project and explain why the proposed solution is important. blocks.en: During our meeting, Dr. Sattely suggested exploring plant-active peptides due to their clear functional literature and rapid environmental breakdown, while emphasizing the need to test purified protectants directly on plants to confirm efficacy before host integration. Additionally, for intracellular protectants like LEA14, she highlighted transport challenges and recommended considering cell-penetrating peptide fusion strategies while ensuring protective signaling does not cause metabolic strain or toxicity.
blocks.text: During our meeting, Dr. Sattely suggested exploring plant-active peptides due to their clear functional literature and rapid environmental breakdown, while emphasizing the need to test purified protectants directly on plants to confirm efficacy before host integration. Additionally, for intracellular protectants like LEA14, she highlighted transport challenges and recommended considering cell-penetrating peptide fusion strategies while ensuring protective signaling does not cause metabolic strain or toxicity.
blocks.zh: 會談中，Dr. Sattely 建議探索植物活性胜肽，因為它們的功能文獻清楚，而且在環境中分解得快；她同時強調，在整合進宿主之前，必須把純化的保護劑直接施用在植物上以確認效力。此外，對於 LEA14 這類細胞內的保護劑，她指出運輸上的困難，建議考慮細胞穿透胜肽的融合策略，同時確保保護性訊號不會造成代謝負擔或毒性。

blocks.en: During our interview, the experts at CH Biotech explained that different crops and protectants require different delivery strategies, recommending that we evaluate root irrigation, foliar spraying, and drone spraying while factoring in production cost per unit area. They advised prioritizing heat and drought stress over salinity based on market need, using Arabidopsis for initial proof-of-concept before moving to high-value crops like tomato or tea leaves, and establishing crop-specific dosage thresholds. Additionally, they recommended using computational screening, protective motif identification, truncated peptides, and point mutations to optimize our protectant designs.
blocks.text: During our interview, the experts at CH Biotech explained that different crops and protectants require different delivery strategies, recommending that we evaluate root irrigation, foliar spraying, and drone spraying while factoring in production cost per unit area. They advised prioritizing heat and drought stress over salinity based on market need, using Arabidopsis for initial proof-of-concept before moving to high-value crops like tomato or tea leaves, and establishing crop-specific dosage thresholds. Additionally, they recommended using computational screening, protective motif identification, truncated peptides, and point mutations to optimize our protectant designs.
blocks.zh: 訪談中，CH Biotech 的專家說明不同作物與不同保護劑需要不同的輸送策略，建議我們評估根部灌溉、葉面噴施與無人機噴施，並把每單位面積的生產成本算進去。他們建議依市場需求把熱逆境與乾旱逆境排在鹽逆境之前，初期概念驗證用 Arabidopsis，之後再轉向番茄或茶葉等高價值作物，並為各作物訂出各自的劑量閾值。此外，他們建議以計算篩選、保護性模組辨識、截短胜肽與點突變來優化保護劑設計。

blocks.en: Event summary

blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: In the BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition, we engaged with different companies, experts, and researchers, gaining many insights from different aspects. One of our most valuable takeaways is that plant stress tolerance depends not only on the presence of protective molecules, such as proline, but also on the processes that regulate their production and use. We also learned that dissolved oxygen monitoring and active aeration/stirring are essential for B. subtilis survival and protein/protectant output, not just passive containment.
blocks.text: In the BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition, we engaged with different companies, experts, and researchers, gaining many insights from different aspects. One of our most valuable takeaways is that plant stress tolerance depends not only on the presence of protective molecules, such as proline, but also on the processes that regulate their production and use. We also learned that dissolved oxygen monitoring and active aeration/stirring are essential for B. subtilis survival and protein/protectant output, not just passive containment.
blocks.zh: 在 BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition，我們與不同企業、專家與研究人員交流，從各個面向得到許多見解。最寶貴的收穫之一是：植物的耐逆境能力不只取決於脯胺酸等保護分子是否存在，也取決於調節它們生成與使用的過程。我們也了解到，對 B. subtilis 的存活與蛋白質／保護劑產出而言，溶氧監測和主動曝氣／攪拌不可或缺，不是只有被動圍阻就夠。

For wetlab, we can investigate irrigation-system-integrated delivery as an alternative to a standalone device and move at least some validation experiments from agar/hydroponics to soil-based trials, and increase sample size.
blocks.text: After hearing different advice from different booths, we realized that we should prioritize an O₂ sensor and feedback loop in our design. blocks.en: On August 6, we also visited Prof. Huang, who is also from NCHU, to evaluate our B. subtilis engineering strategy, protectant delivery methods, plant testing systems, and potential agricultural applications. We discussed optimizing bacterial production, determining protectant concentration and application timing, and selecting suitable delivery methods such as irrigation, spraying, and seed coating. Since our bacteria will be contained in the bioreactor, effective protectant delivery is important for plant responses.
blocks.text: On August 6, we also visited Prof. Huang, who is also from NCHU, to evaluate our B. subtilis engineering strategy, protectant delivery methods, plant testing systems, and potential agricultural applications. We discussed optimizing bacterial production, determining protectant concentration and application timing, and selecting suitable delivery methods such as irrigation, spraying, and seed coating. Since our bacteria will be contained in the bioreactor, effective protectant delivery is important for plant responses.
blocks.zh: 8月6日，我們也拜訪了同在中興大學的 Prof. Huang，評估我們的 B. subtilis 工程策略、保護劑輸送方式、植物測試系統與可能的農業應用。我們討論了優化細菌產出、決定保護劑濃度與施用時機，以及挑選合適的輸送方式，例如灌溉、噴施與種子包衣。由於我們的細菌會被圍阻在生物反應器內，有效的保護劑輸送對植物的反應相當重要。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: This interview helped us better understand that our system effectiveness doesn’t only depend on whether B. subtilis produces protectants, but also on how much protectant reaches the plant, when it is delivered, and how frequently it is applied. We also learned that optimizing the culture medium may help reduce metabolic trade-offs while supporting bacterial growth and protein production. More experiments testing protectant effectiveness are on the Results page.

We also learned that optimizing the culture medium may help reduce metabolic trade-offs while supporting bacterial growth and protein production. More experiments testing protectant effectiveness are on the Results page.
blocks.zh: 這次訪談讓我們更清楚：系統的成效不只取決於 B. subtilis 是否產生保護劑，也取決於有多少保護劑到達植物、什麼時候送到，以及施用得多頻繁。我們也了解到，優化培養基可能有助於降低代謝上的取捨，同時支持細菌生長與蛋白質產出。更多測試保護劑效果的實驗見成果頁面。

blocks.en: Prof. Huang explained that protecting crops depends heavily on getting the timing, dosage, and frequency right to avoid damaging the plant. She noted that protectants like ACCD only need to reach the root zone rather than enter the root directly. To boost protectant production, she recommended adding simple nutrients like soybean meal and brown sugar to the growth medium.

blocks.zh: Prof. Huang 說明，保護作物很大程度取決於把時機、劑量與頻率抓對，才不會傷到植物。她指出像 ACCD 這類保護劑只需要到達根圈，不必直接進入根內。為了提高保護劑產量，她建議在培養基中加入豆粉、黑糖等簡單養分。

blocks.en: To finalize our protectant design and experimental validation strategy, we met with Dr. Elizabeth Sattely and Prof. Drew Endy. Our discussion centered on refining the evaluation of our protectants, distinguishing the secreted protectant from the producer organism, and validating biological mechanisms.

blocks.en: During our meeting with Dr. Sattely and Prof. Endy, our team gained very valuable insights. They mainly focused on how we present our experimental design, controls, mechanism, and the role of ACCD in our system, and suggested that we should keep the explanation clear. They also suggested that we should clearly distinguish between the engineered B. subtilis and the protectant being delivered to plants, demonstrate that the bacteria actually produce and secrete ACCD, and strengthen our experimental controls. Most importantly, they mentioned that clearly communicating the purpose and results of each experiment is crucial.
blocks.text: During our meeting with Dr. Sattely and Prof. Endy, our team gained very valuable insights. They mainly focused on how we present our experimental design, controls, mechanism, and the role of ACCD in our system, and suggested that we should keep the explanation clear. They also suggested that we should clearly distinguish between the engineered B. subtilis and the protectant being delivered to plants, demonstrate that the bacteria actually produce and secrete ACCD, and strengthen our experimental controls. blocks.zh: 與 Dr. Sattely 和 Prof. Endy 的會談中，團隊得到非常寶貴的見解。他們主要關注我們如何呈現實驗設計、對照組、機制，以及 ACCD 在系統中的角色，並建議說明要保持清楚。他們也建議我們清楚區分工程化的 B. subtilis 與送到植物身上的保護劑，證明細菌真的會產生並分泌 ACCD，並強化實驗對照。最重要的是，他們提到把每個實驗的目的與結果講清楚非常關鍵。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: Their feedback shows us that clearly explaining what each result demonstrates and why each experimental choice was made is essential and important. We also need to provide appropriate controls to rule out alternative explanations and verify ACCD production at both the protein and RNA levels, and make our mechanism of action and biosafety rationale easier for judges and audiences to understand.
blocks.text: Their feedback shows us that clearly explaining what each result demonstrates and why each experimental choice was made is essential and important. We also need to provide appropriate controls to rule out alternative explanations and verify ACCD production at both the protein and RNA levels, and make our mechanism of action and biosafety rationale easier for judges and audiences to understand.
blocks.zh: 他們的回饋讓我們看到：把每個結果證明了什麼、每個實驗選擇為什麼這樣做講清楚，是不可或缺的要事。我們也需要提供適當的對照組來排除其他解釋，在蛋白質與 RNA 兩個層級確認 ACCD 的產生，並讓作用機制與生物安全的理由更容易被評審和觀眾理解。

blocks.en: During the joint session, they emphasized the importance of demonstrating protectant production and secretion at both the protein and RNA levels. They advised implementing rigorous experimental controls to isolate the specific biological impact of ACCD on plant stress relief, ensuring that observed protective effects can be directly attributed to protectant activity rather than background systemic responses.
blocks.text: During the joint session, they emphasized the importance of demonstrating protectant production and secretion at both the protein and RNA levels. They advised implementing rigorous experimental controls to isolate the specific biological impact of ACCD on plant stress relief, ensuring that observed protective effects can be directly attributed to protectant activity rather than background systemic responses.
blocks.zh: 在這場聯合會談中，他們強調必須在蛋白質與 RNA 兩個層級證明保護劑的產生與分泌。他們建議建立嚴謹的實驗對照，把 ACCD 對植物逆境緩解的特定生物影響單獨分離出來，確保觀察到的保護效果可以直接歸因於保護劑的活性，而不是背景的系統性反應。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.text: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 結論

blocks.en: These expert consultations helped us shift our Protectant Design pipeline from basic compound testing to a realistic strategy for protecting crops. By focusing on specific stress types, switching to plant-active peptides, and testing in real soil rather than hydroponics, we aligned our work with actual field conditions. Most importantly, we learned that helping plants survive stress isn't just about making a protective compound, but also about getting the dosage, timing, and testing controls right to prove it actually works.
blocks.text: These expert consultations helped us shift our Protectant Design pipeline from basic compound testing to a realistic strategy for protecting crops. Most importantly, we learned that helping plants survive stress isn't just about making a protective compound, but also about getting the dosage, timing, and testing controls right to prove it actually works.
blocks.zh: 這些專家諮詢讓保護劑設計這條脈絡從基礎的化合物測試，轉為一套能真正保護作物的現實策略。我們聚焦特定逆境類型、改用植物活性胜肽、在真實土壤而非水耕中測試，讓工作對準實際的田間條件。最重要的是，我們學到幫助植物撐過逆境不只是做出一個保護化合物，還要把劑量、時機與測試對照抓對，才能證明它真的有效。

blocks.en: Gene circuit and cloning
blocks.text: Gene circuit and cloning
blocks.zh: 基因迴路與選殖

blocks.en: The Genetic Circuit and Cloning pipeline was an important part of our project. It focused on designing, controlling, and testing our engineered Bacillus subtilis strain so it could reliably produce our target protectants. Each interview and meeting with each expert helped us spot technical challenges in the lab, adjust our dry-lab modeling, and refine our biosafety strategy. By talking with researchers in gene circuits, physical containment, and plant biology, we were able to turn our initial circuit concepts into a safe, well-tested biological system.

blocks.en: Event summary

blocks.en: We consulted with Prof. Huang to evaluate the timing, dosage, sensing strategy, and application of our protectant-delivery system. During the discussion, he highlighted that biostimulants can be most effective when applied during the seedling stage to have effects that last longer, which also helps adjust gene regulation signals as cells replicate for long-term protection. Prof. Huang also mentioned that excessive stress or protectant concentrations may affect plant health negatively, so it is important to set appropriate thresholds and validate dosages. From an agricultural angle, hydroponic systems may not completely simulate field conditions, and farmers often prioritize simple application. Therefore, our system should integrate functions such as environmental sensing and weather forecasting to predict stress while keeping it easy for farmers to operate. Prof. Huang also kindly provided us with the B. subtilis WB800 strain, which we further used in other experiments.
blocks.text: We consulted with Prof. Huang to evaluate the timing, dosage, sensing strategy, and application of our protectant-delivery system. During the discussion, he highlighted that biostimulants can be most effective when applied during the seedling stage to have effects that last longer, which also helps adjust gene regulation signals as cells replicate for long-term protection. Prof. Huang also mentioned that excessive stress or protectant concentrations may affect plant health negatively, so it is important to set appropriate thresholds and validate dosages. From an agricultural angle, hydroponic systems may not completely simulate field conditions, and farmers often prioritize simple application. Therefore, our system should integrate functions such as environmental sensing and weather forecasting to predict stress while keeping it easy for farmers to operate. Prof. Huang also kindly provided us with the B. subtilis WB800 strain, which we further used in other experiments.
blocks.zh: 我們諮詢 Prof. Huang，評估保護劑輸送系統的時機、劑量、感測策略與施用方式。討論中他指出，生物刺激素在苗期施用效果可能最好，作用也維持得比較久；這同時有助於隨著細胞複製調整基因調控訊號，形成長期保護。Prof. Huang 也提到，逆境或保護劑濃度過高可能對植物健康造成負面影響，因此設定合適的閾值並驗證劑量很重要。從農業角度看，水耕系統可能無法完全模擬田間條件，而農友通常最在意施用是否簡單。因此我們的系統應該整合環境感測與天氣預報等功能來預測逆境，同時維持農友容易操作。Prof. Huang 也慷慨提供我們 B. subtilis WB800 菌株，我們後續在其他實驗中使用。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: This meeting changed our understanding of when and how our bioreactor should respond to stress. We also learned that different protectants may require different amounts of time, some can prime plants before stress, and others may be more effective when stress occurs. This led us to consider periodic rather than continuous operation and seedling-stage application as alternative strategies.
blocks.text: This meeting changed our understanding of when and how our bioreactor should respond to stress. We also learned that different protectants may require different amounts of time, some can prime plants before stress, and others may be more effective when stress occurs. This led us to consider periodic rather than continuous operation and seedling-stage application as alternative strategies.
blocks.zh: 這次會談改變了我們對生物反應器該在何時、以什麼方式回應逆境的理解。我們也了解到不同保護劑需要的時間不同：有些可以在逆境來臨前先讓植物預馴，有些則在逆境發生時更有效。這讓我們把週期性運轉（而非連續運轉）與苗期施用列為替代策略來考慮。

blocks.en: Consider including both vector control and no-plasmid control groups to check for native resistance. Use an increasingly nutrient-poor medium as a backup method.
blocks.text: Consider including both vector control and no-plasmid control groups to check for native resistance. Use an increasingly nutrient-poor medium as a backup method.
blocks.zh: 考慮同時納入載體對照組與無質體對照組，以檢查是否存在原生抗性。以逐步減少養分的培養基作為備用方法。

blocks.en: Professor Huang explained that running our genetic circuit continuously could lead to excessively high protectant concentrations that harm host cells. He recommended designing our circuit logic for periodic activation rather than continuous release to regulate expression levels. To execute this circuit design in the lab, we updated our cloning workflow by using dense cell pellets and DNA (>10k) for electroporation, troubleshooting ligations, verifying the green reporter gene in B. subtilis, and running dual controls (vector control + no-plasmid control) alongside nutrient-poor media selection to check for native antibiotic resistance. Despite these cloning adjustments, we still faced wet-lab issues with low protein expression yields, secretion efficiency, and construct design issues, leading us to meet up again with Professor Huang, Chieh-Chen to obtain more valuable advice.

To execute this circuit design in the lab, we updated our cloning workflow by using dense cell pellets and DNA (>10k) for electroporation, troubleshooting ligations, verifying the green reporter gene in B. subtilis, and running dual controls (vector control + no-plasmid control) alongside nutrient-poor media selection to check for native antibiotic resistance. Despite these cloning adjustments, we still faced wet-lab issues with low protein expression yields, secretion efficiency, and construct design issues, leading us to meet up again with Professor Huang, Chieh-Chen to obtain more valuable advice.
blocks.zh: Professor Huang 說明，讓基因迴路連續運轉可能導致保護劑濃度過高，傷害宿主細胞。他建議把迴路邏輯設計成週期性啟動而非連續釋放，以調節表現量。為了在實驗室執行這個迴路設計，我們更新了選殖流程：電穿孔時使用高密度細胞沉澱與 DNA（>10k）、排除接合反應的問題、在 B. subtilis 中確認綠色報告基因，並同時跑雙重對照（載體對照加上無質體對照）與低養分培養基篩選，以檢查是否存在原生的抗生素抗性。即使做了這些選殖上的調整，我們在濕式實驗上仍遇到蛋白質表現量低、分泌效率與構築設計的問題，於是再次與 Professor Huang, Chieh-Chen 會面，取得更多寶貴建議。

blocks.en: After the last meeting with Prof. Huang, we visited him at NCHU in person to gain some feedback on our project direction. For wetlab, the discussion focused on improving protein expression and secretion. For the plant model, he advised establishing a clear experimental rationale for salinity and heat stress across agar, hydroponic, and soil systems. For drylab, the focus shifted toward designing shorter or modified peptide constructs while retaining biological activity, and using receptor–peptide interactions to guide construct selection.
blocks.text: After the last meeting with Prof. Huang, we visited him at NCHU in person to gain some feedback on our project direction. For wetlab, the discussion focused on improving protein expression and secretion. For the plant model, he advised establishing a clear experimental rationale for salinity and heat stress across agar, hydroponic, and soil systems. For drylab, the focus shifted toward designing shorter or modified peptide constructs while retaining biological activity, and using receptor–peptide interactions to guide construct selection.
blocks.zh: 上一次會談之後，我們親自到中興大學拜訪 Prof. Huang，取得對專案方向的回饋。濕式實驗方面，討論聚焦在提升蛋白質表現與分泌。植物模式方面，他建議為瓊脂、水耕與土壤三種系統中的鹽逆境與熱逆境建立清楚的實驗依據。乾式實驗方面，重點轉向設計較短或經修改的胜肽構築，同時保留生物活性，並以受體–胜肽的交互作用來指引構築的選擇。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: The consultation helped us improve our understanding of protein and plant models. We recognized that only improving secretion is insufficient if the resulting protein does not retain its activity, so protein quantity, identity, solubility, and function need to be evaluated together.
blocks.text: The consultation helped us improve our understanding of protein and plant models. We recognized that only improving secretion is insufficient if the resulting protein does not retain its activity, so protein quantity, identity, solubility, and function need to be evaluated together.
blocks.zh: 這次諮詢讓我們對蛋白質與植物模式的理解更進一步。我們認知到，如果產出的蛋白質沒有保留活性，單純提升分泌量是不夠的，因此蛋白質的量、身分、溶解度與功能必須一起評估。

blocks.en: During our last meeting, we met in-person with Professor Huang, Chieh-Chen to address our remaining genetic circuit and cloning challenges. Our discussion focused on strategies to improve protein expression and secretion efficiency in B. subtilis. shifted toward designing shorter or modified peptide constructs that retain their biological activity, using receptor-peptide interaction models to guide our construct selection. This meeting made us realize that boosting secretion alone is useless if the expressed protein loses its functional activity, leading us to establish a unified evaluation approach where protein quantity, identity, solubility, and functional activity are tested together.

blocks.zh: 最後一次會談中，我們親自與 Professor Huang, Chieh-Chen 面談，處理基因迴路與選殖上剩下的難題。討論聚焦在提升 B. subtilis 中蛋白質表現與分泌效率的策略。重點轉向設計較短或經修改、但仍保留生物活性的胜肽構築，並以受體–胜肽交互作用模型指引構築的選擇。這次會談讓我們意識到，如果表現出的蛋白質失去功能活性，單純提升分泌量沒有用；因此我們建立了統一的評估方式，把蛋白質的量、身分、溶解度與功能活性一起測試。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.text: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 結論

blocks.en: Overall, these consultations transformed our project ideas into a circuit with thought-out parts. By addressing biosafety and execution step by step, we successfully shifted our safety focus to physical containment, changed our circuit logic to periodic release, and refined our wet-lab protocols.

By addressing biosafety and execution step by step, we successfully shifted our safety focus to physical containment, changed our circuit logic to periodic release, and refined our wet-lab protocols.
blocks.zh: 整體來說，這些諮詢把專案的構想變成一條由仔細選過的元件組成的迴路。我們一步步處理生物安全與實作問題，把安全重心轉向物理圍阻、把迴路邏輯改成週期性釋放，並修整了濕式實驗流程。

blocks.en: Bioreactor and hardware
blocks.text: Bioreactor and hardware
blocks.zh: 生物反應器與硬體

blocks.en: Our bioreactor and hardware serve as the physical interface between our engineered B. subtilis and the plant. Instead of releasing engineered bacteria directly into the environment, we designed a controlled system that can maintain the bacteria, produce protectants, and deliver them to the plant while minimizing bacterial leakage. Through expert consultations, we continuously refined the bioreactor to improve containment, production, monitoring, and practical deployment.

blocks.en: In June, Prof. Chang visited our team and discussed our bioreactor design with us while also providing valuable insights for the B. subtilis challenges. The main problem we wanted to consult was the design of our hollow-fiber membrane bioreactor.
blocks.text: In June, Prof. Chang visited our team and discussed our bioreactor design with us while also providing valuable insights for the B. subtilis challenges. The main problem we wanted to consult was the design of our hollow-fiber membrane bioreactor.
blocks.zh: 六月，Prof. Chang 來訪並與我們討論生物反應器設計，同時針對 B. subtilis 的難題提供寶貴見解。我們主要想請教的問題是中空纖維膜生物反應器的設計。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: From Prof. Chang’s experience, we gained a better understanding of B. subtilis, specifically the best growing conditions. He also mentioned a solution to the foaming issue by introducing a mechanical design that physically disrupts and breaks the bubbles. For the hollow fiber membrane, he noted that monitoring the flow rate and transmembrane pressure (Refer to Perfusion Bioreactor page) is essential for filtration - indicates the caking issue.
blocks.text: From Prof. Chang’s experience, we gained a better understanding of B. subtilis, specifically the best growing conditions. He also mentioned a solution to the foaming issue by introducing a mechanical design that physically disrupts and breaks the bubbles. For the hollow fiber membrane, he noted that monitoring the flow rate and transmembrane pressure (Refer to Perfusion Bioreactor page) is essential for filtration - indicates the caking issue.
blocks.zh: 從 Prof. Chang 的經驗，我們對 B. subtilis（特別是最佳生長條件）有了更好的理解。他也提出起泡問題的解法：加入以機械方式打散、破除氣泡的設計。中空纖維膜方面，他指出監測流速與跨膜壓差（參見灌流式生物反應器頁面）對過濾不可或缺，這也反映出結餅的問題。

blocks.en: These hardware problems also showed us that simply building a functioning bioreactor was not enough. We needed to understand how the hardware, biological system, and mathematical model interacted. This brought us back to Professor Chen, who emphasized the need to connect experimental data with modeling and establish a feedback loop between our experiments and simulations. As a result, we expanded our testing and began considering parameters such as dissolved oxygen, treatment duration, dosage, and hydroponic conditions.
blocks.text: These hardware problems also showed us that simply building a functioning bioreactor was not enough. blocks.zh: 這些硬體問題也讓我們看到，單純造出一台能運作的生物反應器並不夠。我們必須理解硬體、生物系統與數學模型之間如何互動。這讓我們再次回到 Professor Chen，他強調必須把實驗數據與建模連起來，並在實驗與模擬之間建立回饋迴路。因此我們擴大測試，開始把溶氧、處理時間、劑量與水耕條件等參數納入考量。

blocks.en: As we connected our hardware with our experimental system, we realized that we still needed to understand what the bioreactor would require outside of controlled laboratory conditions. This motivated us to engage with companies, researchers, and experts at BIO Asia-Taiwan. Their feedback highlighted that dissolved oxygen and active aeration were important not only for containment, but also for maintaining B. subtilis and achieving reliable protectant production. This led us to prioritize an O₂ sensor and feedback loop in our hardware.

blocks.en: Bio Asia-Taiwan Exhibition 2026 is a public biotechnology exhibition held in Nangang, Taipei, Taiwan. ReLEAF attended the event in order to explore novel biotechnology innovations and gain feedback on our product. Through this event, we gained insight on plant stress tolerance and the necessities for B. subtilis survival.
blocks.text: Bio Asia-Taiwan Exhibition 2026 is a public biotechnology exhibition held in Nangang, Taipei, Taiwan. ReLEAF attended the event in order to explore novel biotechnology innovations and gain feedback on our product. Through this event, we gained insight on plant stress tolerance and the necessities for B. subtilis survival.
blocks.zh: Bio Asia-Taiwan Exhibition 2026 是在臺灣臺北南港舉辦的公開生技展。ReLEAF 參加這場活動，是為了接觸新的生技創新，並取得對我們產品的回饋。透過這場活動，我們對植物耐逆境能力與 B. subtilis 存活所需的條件有了認識。

blocks.en: Event summary
blocks.text: Event summary
blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: In the BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition, we engaged with different companies, experts, and researchers, gaining many insights from different aspects. One of our most valuable takeaways is that plant stress tolerance depends not only on the presence of protective molecules, such as proline, but also on the processes that regulate their production and use. We also learned that dissolved oxygen monitoring and active aeration/stirring are essential for B. subtilis survival and protein/protectant output, not just passive containment.
blocks.text: In the BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition, we engaged with different companies, experts, and researchers, gaining many insights from different aspects. One of our most valuable takeaways is that plant stress tolerance depends not only on the presence of protective molecules, such as proline, but also on the processes that regulate their production and use. We also learned that dissolved oxygen monitoring and active aeration/stirring are essential for B. subtilis survival and protein/protectant output, not just passive containment.
blocks.zh: 在 BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition，我們與不同企業、專家與研究人員交流，從各個面向得到許多見解。最寶貴的收穫之一是：植物的耐逆境能力不只取決於脯胺酸等保護分子是否存在，也取決於調節它們生成與使用的過程。我們也了解到，對 B. subtilis 的存活與蛋白質／保護劑產出而言，溶氧監測和主動曝氣／攪拌不可或缺，不是只有被動圍阻就夠。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: After hearing different advice from different booths, we realized that we should prioritize an O₂ sensor and feedback loop in our design. For wetlab, we can investigate irrigation-system-integrated delivery as an alternative to a standalone device and move at least some validation experiments from agar/hydroponics to soil-based trials, and increase sample size.
blocks.text: After hearing different advice from different booths, we realized that we should prioritize an O₂ sensor and feedback loop in our design. For wetlab, we can investigate irrigation-system-integrated delivery as an alternative to a standalone device and move at least some validation experiments from agar/hydroponics to soil-based trials, and increase sample size.
blocks.zh: 聽過各攤位不同的建議後，我們意識到設計上應該優先納入 O₂ 感測器與回饋迴路。濕式實驗方面，我們可以研究把輸送整合進灌溉系統，作為獨立裝置的替代方案；並至少把部分驗證實驗從瓊脂／水耕移到土壤試驗，同時加大樣本數。

blocks.en: BIO Asia-Taiwan also made us question whether our hardware could adapt to different agricultural environments and delivery systems. We therefore visited Yes Health iFarm to better understand how environmental conditions are monitored and controlled in an actual plant-growing system. Their hydroponic system showed us the importance of continuous circulation, aeration, environmental monitoring, and crop-specific conditions. This encouraged us to reconsider our experimental setup and make ReLEAF more adaptable to different crops and growing environments.
blocks.text: BIO Asia-Taiwan also made us question whether our hardware could adapt to different agricultural environments and delivery systems. We therefore visited Yes Health iFarm to better understand how environmental conditions are monitored and controlled in an actual plant-growing system. Their hydroponic system showed us the importance of continuous circulation, aeration, environmental monitoring, and crop-specific conditions. This encouraged us to reconsider our experimental setup and make ReLEAF more adaptable to different crops and growing environments.
blocks.zh: BIO Asia-Taiwan 也讓我們反問：我們的硬體能不能適應不同的農業環境與輸送系統？於是我們參訪 Yes Health iFarm，以更了解實際植物栽培系統如何監測與控制環境條件。他們的水耕系統讓我們看到連續循環、曝氣、環境監測與依作物調整條件的重要性。這鼓勵我們重新思考實驗設置，並讓 ReLEAF 更能適應不同作物與栽培環境。

Although we were unable to obtain some of the exact technical data we needed, the discussion provided important design insights for ReLEAF.
blocks.text: The visit to Yes Health iFarm helped us understand how a highly controlled hydroponic system manages plant growth through environmental monitoring, nutrient management, lighting, aeration, and water circulation. Although we were unable to obtain some of the exact technical data we needed, the discussion provided important design insights for ReLEAF.
blocks.zh: 參訪 Yes Health iFarm 讓我們了解高度受控的水耕系統如何透過環境監測、養分管理、照明、曝氣與水循環來管理植物生長。雖然我們沒能取得部分需要的確切技術數據，這次討論仍為 ReLEAF 提供了重要的設計見解。

blocks.en: After consulting with the expert from Yes Health iFarm, we gained some valuable insights. The discussion led us to reconsider our experimental conditions, improve the integration of environmental sensors, and design ReLEAF to be adaptable to different crops and growing environments.
blocks.text: After consulting with the expert from Yes Health iFarm, we gained some valuable insights. The discussion led us to reconsider our experimental conditions, improve the integration of environmental sensors, and design ReLEAF to be adaptable to different crops and growing environments.

blocks.en: We may expand ReLEAF from simply detecting environmental stress to eventually detecting nutrient deficiencies and automatically supplying the nutrients plants need.

blocks.en: We also want to shift our project philosophy toward treating plants more like living organisms with individual needs, rather than focusing purely on maximizing economic output.
blocks.text: We also want to shift our project philosophy toward treating plants more like living organisms with individual needs, rather than focusing purely on maximizing economic output.

blocks.en: However, making the system more adaptable introduced another challenge: how could we make all of these components practical and reliable for actual users? This led us to consult Prof. Chang again in September. When we showed him our updated bioreactor, we encountered issues such as protectant and B. subtilis leakage through the hollow-fiber membrane and difficulties interpreting our experimental data. His feedback pushed us to consider not only technical performance, but also usability, AIoT integration, and a replaceable bacterial capsule.
blocks.text: However, making the system more adaptable introduced another challenge: how could we make all of these components practical and reliable for actual users? This led us to consult Prof. Chang again in September. When we showed him our updated bioreactor, we encountered issues such as protectant and B. subtilis leakage through the hollow-fiber membrane and difficulties interpreting our experimental data. His feedback pushed us to consider not only technical performance, but also usability, AIoT integration, and a replaceable bacterial capsule.
blocks.zh: 不過，讓系統更能調適又帶來另一個挑戰：要怎麼讓這些組件對實際使用者來說既實用又可靠？這讓我們在九月再次諮詢 Prof. Chang。我們把更新後的生物反應器拿給他看時，遇到的問題包括保護劑與 B. subtilis 從中空纖維膜滲漏，以及實驗數據難以解讀。他的回饋推著我們不只看技術表現，也要看使用性、AIoT 整合，以及可更換的菌體膠囊。

blocks.en: Mr. Riddler Lu is the founder of Agriweather, which aims to combine IoT technology and data science with local young farmers to create an “agricultural microclimate tool” that integrates data, monitoring, analysis, and expert knowledge.
blocks.text: Mr. Riddler Lu is the founder of Agriweather, which aims to combine IoT technology and data science with local young farmers to create an “agricultural microclimate tool” that integrates data, monitoring, analysis, and expert knowledge.
blocks.zh: Mr. Riddler Lu 是 Agriweather 的創辦人，該公司希望結合物聯網技術與數據科學，與本地的青年農友一起打造一套整合數據、監測、分析與專家知識的「農業微氣候工具」。

blocks.en: Merely having a humidity sensor is insufficient, because there are so many other factors. I would advise you to also add a rain sensor and an EC sensor.
blocks.text: Merely having a humidity sensor is insufficient, because there are so many other factors. I would advise you to also add a rain sensor and an EC sensor.
blocks.zh: 光有濕度感測器不夠，因為還有太多其他因素。我會建議你們再加一個雨量感測器和一個 EC 感測器。

blocks.en: We have collaborations with some agricultural organizations, and from my experience the best advertising is by word of mouth, as farmers often trust research stations, or from farmer to farmer.
blocks.text: We have collaborations with some agricultural organizations, and from my experience the best advertising is by word of mouth, as farmers often trust research stations, or from farmer to farmer.
blocks.zh: 我們和一些農業組織有合作；依我的經驗，最好的宣傳是口碑，因為農友通常信任試驗改良場，或是農友之間互相介紹。

blocks.en: Event summary
blocks.text: Event summary
blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: During our meeting with Mr. Lu, we discussed his company’s business method and his bioreactor, along with asking him questions about the current market of farmers and how he thinks our bioreactor and AIoT can further improve. He advised us to also add a sensor and EC (electrical conductivity sensor) for salinity, along with training our prediction model off of the historical data of the area and to continuously collect data. On the business side, he mentioned that since our bioreactor doesn’t connect to a farm’s irrigation system, it means that farmers have to go there and collect it themselves or use a drone. This means we have to justify the usage of our bioreactor when using a system like theirs that can just control and do everything for them is much more convenient. Mr. Lu also mentioned that we need a more specific adoption plan for farmers, along with the fact that products often pass and become popular by word of mouth, both between farmers and from Ag. Research Extension Branches or researchers that farmers trust.

blocks.en: Coming out of the meeting with Mr. Lu, we gained a deeper understanding of how to format our APP, improve our hardware, and make it so that our business plan is more holistic. We will be focusing on 1 or 2 very specific crops for our project so that we can have a clearer demographic and create a better explanation for the value of having a sensor like ours instead of an automated system that sprays cheaper and easier to transport protectants.

blocks.en: Event summary

blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: Professor Chen Wen-Liang advised us to introduce ReLEAF’s digital twin through its agricultural application scenario rather than starting with theoretical definitions. He emphasized explaining the system’s inputs, outputs, and feedback loop before presenting its architecture and individual components. He also challenged us to clarify why ReLEAF requires a specialized bioreactor, highlighting the hollow-fiber membrane’s intended role in retaining engineered bacteria while allowing plant protectants to pass through. Additionally, he provided positive feedback on our real-time monitoring interface and AI chat interface.
blocks.text: Professor Chen Wen-Liang advised us to introduce ReLEAF’s digital twin through its agricultural application scenario rather than starting with theoretical definitions. He emphasized explaining the system’s inputs, outputs, and feedback loop before presenting its architecture and individual components. He also challenged us to clarify why ReLEAF requires a specialized bioreactor, highlighting the hollow-fiber membrane’s intended role in retaining engineered bacteria while allowing plant protectants to pass through. Additionally, he provided positive feedback on our real-time monitoring interface and AI chat interface.
blocks.zh: Professor Chen Wen-Liang 建議我們從農業應用情境切入介紹 ReLEAF 的數位孿生，而不是從理論定義開始。他強調要先說明系統的輸入、輸出與回饋迴路，再呈現架構與各個組件。他也要我們講清楚 ReLEAF 為什麼需要一台專門的生物反應器，指出中空纖維膜的既定角色是留住工程菌、同時讓植物保護劑通過。此外，他對我們的即時監測介面與 AI 對話介面給了正面回饋。

blocks.en: The consultation helped us improve both our system design rationale and technical communication. We will prioritize the agricultural need, clarify the connections between sensors, the digital model, and bioreactor control, and explain how the hollow-fiber membrane addresses field biosafety requirements. We will also review our model assumptions and restructure our wiki and video to make ReLEAF easier for non-specialist audiences to understand.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.text: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 結論

blocks.en: Through this chain of stakeholder engagement, our hardware underwent a continuous evolution.
blocks.text: Through this chain of stakeholder engagement, our hardware underwent a continuous evolution.
blocks.zh: 透過這一連串的利害關係人互動，我們的硬體持續演進。

blocks.en: Each stakeholder did not simply give us an independent piece of advice. The limitations identified by one stakeholder became the reason we engaged with the next, allowing our bioreactor to evolve through an iterative feedback loop. This transformed ReLEAF from a bioreactor designed mainly to produce protectants into an integrated hardware platform designed to contain, produce, monitor, and deliver protectants in real agricultural environments.
blocks.text: Each stakeholder did not simply give us an independent piece of advice. The limitations identified by one stakeholder became the reason we engaged with the next, allowing our bioreactor to evolve through an iterative feedback loop. This transformed ReLEAF from a bioreactor designed mainly to produce protectants into an integrated hardware platform designed to contain, produce, monitor, and deliver protectants in real agricultural environments.
blocks.zh: 每位利害關係人給的並不只是一條各自獨立的建議。一位利害關係人指出的限制，成了我們去找下一位的理由，讓生物反應器在迭代的回饋迴路中逐步演進。這把 ReLEAF 從一台主要用來產生保護劑的生物反應器，變成一個整合的硬體平台，能在真實農業環境中圍阻、產生、監測並輸送保護劑。

blocks.en: Deployment

blocks.en: Deployment asks whether farmers would use and pay for ReLEAF, and what stands in the way: market, price and law. The deployment pipeline does this for the project, allowing the team to learn more about how products like ours would do on the market, and what the general consensus surrounding it is so that our project can become closer to what farmers actually need.
blocks.text: Deployment asks whether farmers would use and pay for ReLEAF, and what stands in the way: market, price and law. The deployment pipeline does this for the project, allowing the team to learn more about how products like ours would do on the market, and what the general consensus surrounding it is so that our project can become closer to what farmers actually need.
blocks.zh: 落地應用要問的是：農友會不會使用 ReLEAF、願不願意付錢，以及擋在前面的是什麼：市場、價格與法律。落地應用這條脈絡就是為專案做這件事，讓團隊更了解像我們這樣的產品在市場上會如何、外界對它的普遍看法又是什麼，使專案更貼近農友真正的需求。
