blocks.zh: 這個專案起於一個願望：幫助世界各地、尤其是迦納那些受熱逆境所苦的農友。我們的專案部分受到 Ubuntu Social Enterprise Ghana（USE-GH）的啟發，該組織致力於透過讓農友進得去的市場來改變農業面貌。我們聯繫了負責人 Gilbert Nkpeniyeng，希望確認我們認為正在發生的問題。

blocks.text: Gilbert Nkpeniyeng is working at Ubuntu Social Enterprise Ghana, which aims to empower farmers, enhance food security, enhance value addition, and promote environmental stewardship across Ghana.
blocks.zh: Gilbert Nkpeniyeng 在 Ubuntu Social Enterprise Ghana 工作，該組織的目標是賦能農友、提升糧食安全、提高附加價值，並在迦納各地推動環境管理。

blocks.en: Our project was partly inspired by Ubuntu Social Enterprise Ghana (USE-GH), whose mission is to strengthen food security and increase the value of agricultural products. During our meeting with its leader, Gilbert, we asked him various questions about how he runs his business to support peanut farmers in Ghana, along with questions about what farming is like now, and whether or not climate change is as big of a problem as what we’ve seen so far in the news. He not only confirmed that the increasing climate instability is dealing a big blow to farmers that he knows, but he also mentioned that the small farmers were often disadvantaged.
blocks.text: Our project was partly inspired by Ubuntu Social Enterprise Ghana (USE-GH), whose mission is to strengthen food security and increase the value of agricultural products. During our meeting with its leader, Gilbert, we asked him various questions about how he runs his business to support peanut farmers in Ghana, along with questions about what farming is like now, and whether or not climate change is as big of a problem as what we’ve seen so far in the news. He not only confirmed that the increasing climate instability is dealing a big blow to farmers that he knows, but he also mentioned that the small farmers were often disadvantaged.
blocks.zh: 我們的專案部分受到 Ubuntu Social Enterprise Ghana（USE-GH）的啟發，其使命是強化糧食安全並提高農產品的價值。與負責人 Gilbert 會談時，我們問了他許多問題：他如何經營事業來支持迦納的花生農友、現在農業的實際狀況，以及氣候變遷是否真如我們在新聞上看到的那樣嚴重。他不只確認日益加劇的氣候不穩定對他認識的農友造成很大打擊，也提到小農往往處於弱勢。

blocks.en: Through this meeting, we understood the challenges the smallholder farmers are facing and how limited access to resources is affecting them. He also explained the Ghana market, which helped us further develop our business plan (Refer to Entrepreneurship page).

blocks.en: Once the project proposal was accepted, we wanted to gain more advice onto how to actually run a business and what the market is like in Taiwan, which led us to Professor Chen, who runs a smart agriculture business like we plan to, and has a similar sensor system.

He is also the founder of AgriTalk, an AI-driven agricultural technology startup. blocks.en: In April, the meeting with Prof. Chen, also known as the founder of Agritalk, provided us with feedback that shaped the direction of both our hardware development and business plan, which allowed us to gain more understanding of the strategy for setting up a business plan and advised and suggested us on the hardware design.
blocks.text: In April, the meeting with Prof. Chen, also known as the founder of Agritalk, provided us with feedback that shaped the direction of both our hardware development and business plan, which allowed us to gain more understanding of the strategy for setting up a business plan and advised and suggested us on the hardware design.
blocks.zh: 四月與 Prof. Chen（也就是 Agritalk 的創辦人）的會談，給了我們塑造硬體開發與商業計畫方向的回饋，讓我們更了解擬定商業計畫的策略，也在硬體設計上得到他的建議。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: For the business plan strategy, he suggested that we should not only focus on the local market, but also expand it globally (Refer to Entrepreneurship page), as the limited scale of the local market may limit our potential revenue. He highlighted some challenges that we need to address, including farmers’ adoption, competition with chemical fertilizers, limited market, and regulations (Refer to Entrepreneurship page). For the hardware design, he advised us to define a clear input-output mapping and move toward a bioreactor-based system instead of soil release.
blocks.text: For the business plan strategy, he suggested that we should not only focus on the local market, but also expand it globally (Refer to Entrepreneurship page), as the limited scale of the local market may limit our potential revenue. He highlighted some challenges that we need to address, including farmers’ adoption, competition with chemical fertilizers, limited market, and regulations (Refer to Entrepreneurship page). For the hardware design, he advised us to define a clear input-output mapping and move toward a bioreactor-based system instead of soil release.
blocks.zh: 商業計畫策略方面，他建議我們不要只看本地市場，也要擴展到全球（參見創業頁面），因為本地市場規模有限，可能限制我們的潛在營收。他點出幾個我們必須處理的挑戰，包括農友的採用意願、與化學肥料的競爭、市場有限，以及法規（參見創業頁面）。硬體設計方面，他建議我們定義清楚的輸入–輸出對應關係，並走向以生物反應器為基礎的系統，而不是釋放到土壤。

blocks.en: The World Vegetable Center is an international non-profit research-for-development organization which is headquartered in Taiwan. It is a global institution solely dedicated to vegetable research and development. The World Vegetable Center aims to deliver science-based solutions across low- and middle-income countries.
blocks.text: The World Vegetable Center is an international non-profit research-for-development organization which is headquartered in Taiwan. It is a global institution solely dedicated to vegetable research and development. The World Vegetable Center aims to deliver science-based solutions across low- and middle-income countries.
blocks.zh: World Vegetable Center 是總部設在臺灣的國際非營利「研究促進發展」組織，也是全球唯一專門投入蔬菜研發的機構。World Vegetable Center 的目標是在中低收入國家提供以科學為基礎的解方。

blocks.en: Through our meeting with the World Vegetable Center, we gained a better understanding of the challenges faced by smallholder farmers, including climate resilience and the effects of biotic and abiotic stresses on farming.
blocks.text: Through our meeting with the World Vegetable Center, we gained a better understanding of the challenges faced by smallholder farmers, including climate resilience and the effects of biotic and abiotic stresses on farming.

blocks.en: After the meeting, we realized that we needed to demonstrate that our product is environmentally safe, beneficial, and sustainable, as these factors may increase our product’s acceptance among traditional and natural farmers. In addition, we might need to do more regulatory research on the use of GMOs in order to prove it won’t harm the environment (Refer to Laws and Regulations page). (Refer to Laws and Regulations page)
blocks.text: After the meeting, we realized that we needed to demonstrate that our product is environmentally safe, beneficial, and sustainable, as these factors may increase our product’s acceptance among traditional and natural farmers. In addition, we might need to do more regulatory research on the use of GMOs in order to prove it won’t harm the environment (Refer to Laws and Regulations page). (Refer to Laws and Regulations page)
blocks.zh: 會後我們意識到，必須證明我們的產品對環境安全、有益且可永續，因為這些因素可能提高傳統農友與自然農法農友對產品的接受度。此外，我們可能需要在 GMO 使用上做更多法規研究，以證明它不會危害環境（參見法律與法規頁面）。（參見法律與法規頁面）

blocks.en: During Prof. Chen’s visit, he provided feedback on different aspects, including the math model, plant model, protectant, hydroponics, gene circuit, and bioreactor. blocks.text: During Prof. Chen’s visit, he provided feedback on different aspects, including the math model, plant model, protectant, hydroponics, gene circuit, and bioreactor. He highlighted the importance of connecting the experimental data with modeling, identifying the inputs and outputs clearly, and ensuring every model is refined through experimental validation and feedback loops.
blocks.zh: Prof. Chen 來訪時，在數學模型、植物模式、保護劑、水耕、基因迴路與生物反應器等不同面向給了回饋。他強調把實驗數據與建模連起來、清楚界定輸入與輸出，並確保每個模型都透過實驗驗證與回饋迴路持續修整的重要性。

blocks.en: This meeting shows us that we need a better feedback loop for the experiment, hardware, and model, so we can ensure that our experimental results can continuously refine the model. He suggested that we should consider the ReLEAF database as a platform for organizing experimental data and supporting future optimization and agricultural applications. Additionally, Prof. Chen also mentioned that we can potentially visit Yes Health iFarm for gaining a better understanding on hydroponics.
blocks.text: This meeting shows us that we need a better feedback loop for the experiment, hardware, and model, so we can ensure that our experimental results can continuously refine the model. He suggested that we should consider the ReLEAF database as a platform for organizing experimental data and supporting future optimization and agricultural applications. Additionally, Prof. Chen also mentioned that we can potentially visit Yes Health iFarm for gaining a better understanding on hydroponics.
blocks.zh: 這次會談讓我們看到，實驗、硬體與模型之間需要更好的回饋迴路，才能確保實驗結果持續修整模型。他建議我們把 ReLEAF 資料庫視為整理實驗資料、支持未來優化與農業應用的平台。此外，Prof. Chen 也提到我們可以考慮參訪 Yes Health iFarm，以更了解水耕。

blocks.en: Bio Asia-Taiwan Exhibition 2026 is a public biotechnology exhibition held in Nangang, Taipei, Taiwan. ReLEAF attended the event in order to explore novel biotechnology innovations and gain feedback on our product. Through this event, we gained insight on plant stress tolerance and the necessities for B. subtilis survival.
blocks.text: Bio Asia-Taiwan Exhibition 2026 is a public biotechnology exhibition held in Nangang, Taipei, Taiwan. ReLEAF attended the event in order to explore novel biotechnology innovations and gain feedback on our product. Through this event, we gained insight on plant stress tolerance and the necessities for B. subtilis survival.
blocks.zh: Bio Asia-Taiwan Exhibition 2026 是在臺灣臺北南港舉辦的公開生技展。ReLEAF 參加這場活動，是為了接觸新的生技創新，並取得對我們產品的回饋。透過這場活動，我們對植物耐逆境能力與 B. subtilis 存活所需的條件有了認識。

blocks.en: Event summary
blocks.text: Event summary
blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: In the BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition, we engaged with different companies, experts, and researchers, gaining many insights from different aspects. One of our most valuable takeaways is that plant stress tolerance depends not only on the presence of protective molecules, such as proline, but also on the processes that regulate their production and use. We also learned that dissolved oxygen monitoring and active aeration/stirring are essential for B. subtilis survival and protein/protectant output, not just passive containment.
blocks.text: In the BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition, we engaged with different companies, experts, and researchers, gaining many insights from different aspects. One of our most valuable takeaways is that plant stress tolerance depends not only on the presence of protective molecules, such as proline, but also on the processes that regulate their production and use. We also learned that dissolved oxygen monitoring and active aeration/stirring are essential for B. subtilis survival and protein/protectant output, not just passive containment.
blocks.zh: 在 BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition，我們與不同企業、專家與研究人員交流，從各個面向得到許多見解。最寶貴的收穫之一是：植物的耐逆境能力不只取決於脯胺酸等保護分子是否存在，也取決於調節它們生成與使用的過程。我們也了解到，對 B. subtilis 的存活與蛋白質／保護劑產出而言，溶氧監測和主動曝氣／攪拌不可或缺，不是只有被動圍阻就夠。

blocks.en: After hearing different advice from different booths, we realized that we should prioritize an O₂ sensor and feedback loop in our design. For wetlab, we can investigate irrigation-system-integrated delivery as an alternative to a standalone device and move at least some validation experiments from agar/hydroponics to soil-based trials, and increase sample size.
blocks.text: After hearing different advice from different booths, we realized that we should prioritize an O₂ sensor and feedback loop in our design. For wetlab, we can investigate irrigation-system-integrated delivery as an alternative to a standalone device and move at least some validation experiments from agar/hydroponics to soil-based trials, and increase sample size.
blocks.zh: 聽過各攤位不同的建議後，我們意識到設計上應該優先納入 O₂ 感測器與回饋迴路。濕式實驗方面，我們可以研究把輸送整合進灌溉系統，作為獨立裝置的替代方案；並至少把部分驗證實驗從瓊脂／水耕移到土壤試驗，同時加大樣本數。

blocks.en: Event summary
blocks.text: Event summary

blocks.en: By visiting the Smart Agriweek Exhibition, we learned that the main demographic that will be interested in our product is young farmers, but it also means that we need to find ways to convince older farmers to also adopt our product. Moreover, regulations will definitely be hard for us as a product that uses GMOs. Additionally, we now know that we have a pricing and value advantage, as our product counts as many products in one for a much lower price than it would take for a farmer to, for example, buy both BioBar and Agriweather’s products. Talking with them also allowed us to receive confirmation that government sectors are willing to help and subsidize products that are like ours if necessary (Refer to Entrepreneurship page).

Additionally, we now know that we have a pricing and value advantage, as our product counts as many products in one for a much lower price than it would take for a farmer to, for example, buy both BioBar and Agriweather’s products. blocks.text: Their feedback emphasized the importance of having a clear data interpretation to support our experimental data. blocks.zh: 他們的回饋強調，必須有清楚的數據解讀來支撐實驗數據。這也鼓勵我們更聚焦農友的需求，讓專案的敘事更以問題為導向，同時把科學動機與發現更清楚地呈現給不同觀眾與利害關係人。

blocks.en: During the meeting with Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei, he inspired us to contact people working for further collaboration. The interview with Director Wu is one we have been waiting for a long time, as many different professors and stakeholders have told us that we need to look more into regulations and understand the regulations in Taiwan. After being unable to find the right branch of the Ministry of Agriculture at SMART Agriweek, we reached out to Director Wu at the Miaoli District Agricultural Research and Extension Station. The meeting with Director Wu finally allowed us to confirm our current beliefs about the system and gain answers to the questions we had about regulations and farmers in Taiwan.

blocks.en: Event summary
blocks.text: Event summary
blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: During the meeting with Director Wu, she mainly consulted us on regulation, adoption, cost, and business. This consultation highlighted the need to calculate the cost of operating ReLEAF, including labor, bacterial cultivation, and waste management. She also encouraged us to identify more commercially valuable crops that are vulnerable to environmental stress as our target crop in the business plan. It emphasized the need to demonstrate the effectiveness of the protectant, ensure biosafety, and treat agricultural waste.
blocks.text: During the meeting with Director Wu, she mainly consulted us on regulation, adoption, cost, and business. This consultation highlighted the need to calculate the cost of operating ReLEAF, including labor, bacterial cultivation, and waste management. She also encouraged us to identify more commercially valuable crops that are vulnerable to environmental stress as our target crop in the business plan. It emphasized the need to demonstrate the effectiveness of the protectant, ensure biosafety, and treat agricultural waste.
blocks.zh: 與 Director Wu 的會談中，她主要就法規、採用、成本與營運給我們建議。這次諮詢點出必須算出 ReLEAF 的運作成本，包括人力、菌體培養與廢棄物處理。她也鼓勵我們在商業計畫中，找出更具商業價值、又容易受環境逆境影響的作物作為目標作物。這也強調了必須證明保護劑的效果、確保生物安全，並處理農業廢棄物。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: The interview made us narrow our crop focus, rework our cost and pricing story, and plan for regulation and adoption. In Dry Lab, we will investigate crop-specific stress patterns and update our regional data. For human practices and the business plan, we will account for hidden costs, evaluate different pricing and adoption models, and clarify the regulatory pathway and biosafety requirements. Additionally, based on Director Wu’s suggestion, we changed our target crop to cherry tomato and strawberry since rice is overabundant.

blocks.zh: 這次訪談讓我們收窄作物焦點、重做成本與定價的說法，並為法規與採用做規劃。乾式實驗方面，我們會研究各作物特有的逆境型態，並更新區域資料。人類實踐與商業計畫方面，我們會把隱藏成本算進來、評估不同的定價與採用模式，並釐清法規途徑與生物安全要求。此外，依 Director Wu 的建議，由於稻米供給過剩，我們把目標作物改為小番茄與草莓。

blocks.en: Mr. Lu is the founder of the company Agriweather, a company that has a sensor and regulator system that connects to the irrigation system in farms, which allows farmers to automate the farm. His company has been running for about 8 years.
blocks.text: Mr. Lu is the founder of the company Agriweather, a company that has a sensor and regulator system that connects to the irrigation system in farms, which allows farmers to automate the farm. His company has been running for about 8 years.
blocks.zh: Mr. Lu 是 Agriweather 的創辦人，該公司的感測與調控系統可以接上農場的灌溉系統，讓農友把農場自動化。公司已經營運大約 8 年。

blocks.en: It’s more ideal if you can make the system with automatic control as the labor shortage in agriculture is a global problem now, so asking someone to go to the field is hard.

blocks.zh: 如果你們能把系統做成自動控制會更理想，因為農業缺工現在是全球的問題，要請人到田裡去很難。

blocks.en: We have collaborations with some agricultural organizations, and from my experience the best advertising is by word of mouth, as farmers often trust research stations, or from farmer to farmer.
blocks.text: We have collaborations with some agricultural organizations, and from my experience the best advertising is by word of mouth, as farmers often trust research stations, or from farmer to farmer.
blocks.zh: 我們和一些農業組織有合作；依我的經驗，最好的宣傳是口碑，因為農友通常信任試驗改良場，或是農友之間互相介紹。

blocks.en: Event summary
blocks.text: Event summary
blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: During our meeting with Mr. Lu, we discussed his company’s business method and his bioreactor, along with asking him questions about the current market of farmers and how he thinks our bioreactor and AIoT can further improve. He advised us to also add a sensor and EC (electrical conductivity) for salinity, along with training our prediction model off of the historical data of the area and to continuously collect data. On the business side, he mentioned that since our bioreactor doesn’t connect to a farm’s irrigation system, it means that farmers have to go there and collect it themselves or use a drone. This means we have to justify the usage of our bioreactor when using a system like theirs that can just control and do everything for them is much more convenient. Mr. Lu also mentioned that we need a more specific adoption plan for farmers, along with the fact that products often pass and become popular by word of mouth, both between farmers and from Ag. Research Extension Branches or researchers that farmers trust.

blocks.zh: 與 Mr. Lu 的會談中，我們討論了他公司的經營方式與他的生物反應器，也問了他目前農友市場的情況，以及他認為我們的生物反應器與 AIoT 還能如何改進。他建議我們再加一個感測器，以及測鹽度的 EC（電導度），並用當地的歷史資料訓練預測模型、持續收集數據。商業面向，他提到我們的生物反應器沒有接上農場的灌溉系統，意思是農友得自己過去取用，或改用無人機。這表示當別人用的系統可以把一切都控制好、方便得多時，我們必須說明使用我們生物反應器的理由。Mr. Lu 也提到我們需要一份更具體的農友採用計畫，而且產品常是靠口碑流行起來的，既在農友之間，也來自農友信任的農業改良場分場或研究人員。

blocks.en: Coming out of the meeting with Mr. Lu, we gained a deeper understanding of how to format our APP, improve our hardware, and make it so that our business plan is more holistic. We will be focusing on 1 or 2 very specific crops for our project so that we can have a clearer demographic and create a better explanation for the value of having a sensor like ours instead of an automated system that sprays cheaper and easier to transport protectants.

We will be focusing on 1 or 2 very specific crops for our project so that we can have a clearer demographic and create a better explanation for the value of having a sensor like ours instead of an automated system that sprays cheaper and easier to transport protectants.

blocks.en: On October 20, 2026, Mr. Airy Quillere, Attaché for University Cooperation and Ms. Sasha Ting, Project Officer for Science and Academic Cooperation welcomed GEMS Academy students at the French Office in Taipei.
blocks.text: On October 20, 2026, Mr. Airy Quillere, Attaché for University Cooperation and Ms. Sasha Ting, Project Officer for Science and Academic Cooperation welcomed GEMS Academy students at the French Office in Taipei.
blocks.zh: 2026年10月20日，大學合作專員 Mr. Airy Quillere 與科學暨學術合作專案官員 Ms. Sasha Ting 在法國在台辦事處接待 GEMS Academy 的學生。

blocks.en: The GEMS Academy team presented their project for the iGEM competition in Paris in November 2026. The project originated from their efforts to help farmers address challenges caused by extreme weather conditions. The team described their research process, experiments, and plans to commercialize their product internationally.
blocks.text: The GEMS Academy team presented their project for the iGEM competition in Paris in November 2026. The project originated from their efforts to help farmers address challenges caused by extreme weather conditions. The team described their research process, experiments, and plans to commercialize their product internationally.
blocks.zh: GEMS Academy 團隊介紹了他們要帶到 2026 年 11 月巴黎 iGEM 競賽的專案。這個專案源於他們想幫助農友處理極端天氣造成的難題。團隊說明了研究過程、實驗，以及把產品國際商業化的計畫。

blocks.en: Mr. Quillere was impressed by the considerable time and effort the students had dedicated to the project. He also raised questions about its feasibility and sustainability, including practical concerns such as, “Could farmers afford these IoT technologies?”
blocks.text: Mr. Quillere was impressed by the considerable time and effort the students had dedicated to the project. He also raised questions about its feasibility and sustainability, including practical concerns such as, “Could farmers afford these IoT technologies?”
blocks.zh: 學生投入專案的大量時間與心力讓 Mr. Quillere 印象深刻。他也對可行性與永續性提出問題，包括「農友負擔得起這些物聯網技術嗎？」這類實務上的疑慮。

blocks.en: The students responded with specific figures and explained how they had visited farmers, consulted them about their needs, and incorporated their feedback into the development of the proposed solution. This demonstrated that the project had been evaluated by its intended end users — the farmers themselves.
blocks.text: The students responded with specific figures and explained how they had visited farmers, consulted them about their needs, and incorporated their feedback into the development of the proposed solution. blocks.en: Conclusion

blocks.en: Through these consultations, we further refine our project direction and develop our business plan to better address the farmers’ needs. By engaging with experts, agricultural organizations, and industry professionals, we gained a deeper understanding of the challenges involved in commercialization, including regulatory requirements, biosafety, production costs, and farmer adoption.

By engaging with experts, agricultural organizations, and industry professionals, we gained a deeper understanding of the challenges involved in commercialization, including regulatory requirements, biosafety, production costs, and farmer adoption.
blocks.zh: 透過這些諮詢，我們進一步修整專案方向、發展商業計畫，以更貼近農友的需求。與專家、農業組織和業界人士互動，讓我們更深入理解商業化涉及的難題，包括法規要求、生物安全、生產成本與農友採用。

blocks.en: Continuous engagement

blocks.en: In our Human Practice journey, while conducting interviews and meetings with the numerous stakeholders, we realized something important; that human practices is an ongoing dialogue that never ends, not just one time meetings. While early conversations helped us set our baseline ideas, our project only took real shape when we went back to our advisors with physical prototypes, fresh wet-lab data, and updated circuit designs.
blocks.text: In our Human Practice journey, while conducting interviews and meetings with the numerous stakeholders, we realized something important; that human practices is an ongoing dialogue that never ends, not just one time meetings. While early conversations helped us set our baseline ideas, our project only took real shape when we went back to our advisors with physical prototypes, fresh wet-lab data, and updated circuit designs.
blocks.zh: 在人類實踐的歷程裡，一邊與眾多利害關係人訪談、開會，我們意識到一件重要的事：人類實踐是不會結束的持續對話，不是一次性的會面。早期的對談幫我們定下基本構想，但專案真正成形，是在我們帶著實體原型、新鮮的濕式實驗數據與更新後的迴路設計回去找顧問之後。

blocks.en: By setting up continuous feedback loops with five core experts, we turned our project from a loose theoretical idea into a working reactor prototype. Each follow-up meeting pushed us to fix design flaws, refine our controls, and make our system realistic for actual farmers.
blocks.text: By setting up continuous feedback loops with five core experts, we turned our project from a loose theoretical idea into a working reactor prototype. Each follow-up meeting pushed us to fix design flaws, refine our controls, and make our system realistic for actual farmers.

blocks.en: Advice

blocks.en: During our initial consultation on March 27, 2026, Professor Cheng reviewed our proposed engineered Bacillus subtilis system and agreed with our focus on abiotic stresses like heat, salinity, and drought, as well as choosing Arabidopsis thaliana as a model organism. However, she pointed out that experimental procedures themselves can interfere with plant stress responses and warned that hydroponics alone might be unstable for testing. She suggested prioritizing growth on agar plates for early-stage control before carefully transferring plants to soil, and kindly provided us with Arabidopsis seeds along with valuable guidance on their cultivation and optimal growing conditions.
blocks.text: During our initial consultation on March 27, 2026, Professor Cheng reviewed our proposed engineered Bacillus subtilis system and agreed with our focus on abiotic stresses like heat, salinity, and drought, as well as choosing Arabidopsis thaliana as a model organism. However, she pointed out that experimental procedures themselves can interfere with plant stress responses and warned that hydroponics alone might be unstable for testing. She suggested prioritizing growth on agar plates for early-stage control before carefully transferring plants to soil, and kindly provided us with Arabidopsis seeds along with valuable guidance on their cultivation and optimal growing conditions.
blocks.zh: 2026年3月27日的第一次諮詢中，Professor Cheng 檢視了我們提出的工程化 Bacillus subtilis 系統，同意我們聚焦熱、鹽度、乾旱等非生物逆境，也同意以 Arabidopsis thaliana 作為模式生物。不過她指出，實驗流程本身就可能干擾植物的逆境反應，並提醒單用水耕測試可能不夠穩定。她建議前期先以瓊脂培養盤栽培為主以便控制，之後再小心把植物移到土壤；她也慷慨提供我們 Arabidopsis 種子，以及栽培方式與最適生長條件的寶貴指引。

blocks.en: Following her feedback, we shifted away from relying strictly on hydroponics, dropped osmotic stress because of testing resource constraints, adopted a plate-to-soil transition model, and incorporated visual ROS staining along with detectable phenotypic and biochemical outputs.
blocks.text: Following her feedback, we shifted away from relying strictly on hydroponics, dropped osmotic stress because of testing resource constraints, adopted a plate-to-soil transition model, and incorporated visual ROS staining along with detectable phenotypic and biochemical outputs.
blocks.zh: 依她的回饋，我們不再完全依賴水耕，因測試資源有限而放棄滲透逆境，改採培養盤到土壤的轉移模式，並納入可目視的 ROS 染色，以及可偵測的表現型與生化輸出。

blocks.text: He evaluated our progress and noted that our dry-lab modeling and wet-lab experiments were operating separately instead of informing each other. He urged us to build a dynamic feedback loop where experimental data directly calibrates model parameters. blocks.zh: 他評估我們的進度，指出乾式實驗的建模與濕式實驗是各自分開運作，沒有彼此回饋。他要我們建立動態的回饋迴路，讓實驗數據直接校正模型參數。此外，他建議測試不同鹽濃度與處理時間、監測溶氧，並參訪 Yes Health iFarm 以更了解產業規模的水耕。

blocks.en: During our initial consultation on June 27, 2026, Dr. Sattely evaluated our protectant selection, delivery strategy, and overall project direction. She pointed out that targeting multiple abiotic stresses simultaneously weakened our proof of concept. She emphasized that we should clearly define our project goals and milestones, focusing deeply on validating one target stress. Additionally, she suggested testing the purified protectant directly on plants before integrating it into the full bacterial system, while also encouraging us to explore alternative protective molecules such as peptides.

blocks.zh: 2026年6月27日的第一次諮詢中，Dr. Sattely 評估了我們的保護劑選擇、輸送策略與整體專案方向。她指出同時針對多種非生物逆境會削弱我們的概念驗證。她強調我們應該清楚定義專案目標與里程碑，深入專注驗證一種目標逆境。此外，她建議在把保護劑整合進整套細菌系統之前，先把純化後的保護劑直接施用在植物上測試，同時也鼓勵我們探索胜肽等其他保護分子。

blocks.en: Advice
blocks.text: Advice
blocks.zh: 建議

blocks.en: During our initial meeting on July 28, 2026, Professor Huang evaluated the timing, dosage, sensing strategy, and agricultural application of our protectant-delivery system. He highlighted that biostimulants are most effective when applied at the seedling stage to establish long-term gene regulation signals, while warning that excessive protectant or stress concentrations cause phytotoxicity. Furthermore, he noted that hydroponics do not fully simulate field soil conditions and emphasized that farmers prioritize simple operations. He recommended integrating environmental sensing and weather forecasting to predict stress early while keeping system operation straightforward.

He highlighted that biostimulants are most effective when applied at the seedling stage to establish long-term gene regulation signals, while warning that excessive protectant or stress concentrations cause phytotoxicity. Furthermore, he noted that hydroponics do not fully simulate field soil conditions and emphasized that farmers prioritize simple operations. He recommended integrating environmental sensing and weather forecasting to predict stress early while keeping system operation straightforward.
blocks.zh: 2026年7月28日的第一次會面中，Professor Huang 評估了保護劑輸送系統的時機、劑量、感測策略與農業應用。他指出生物刺激素在苗期施用效果最好，可以建立長期的基因調控訊號；同時提醒保護劑或逆境濃度過高會造成植物毒害。他並指出水耕無法完全模擬田間土壤條件，強調農友最在意操作簡單。他建議整合環境感測與天氣預報以提早預測逆境，同時讓系統操作保持簡明。

blocks.en: What we changed
blocks.text: What we changed

blocks.en: In response, we combined physical sensors (pH, soil moisture) with weather forecasting models and AI for predictive release, shifted our bioreactor from continuous operation to a periodic activation model to clear free radicals without over-dosing, adapted our testing to soil environments with strict dosage validation, and refined our wet-lab control groups and electroporation parameters.
blocks.text: In response, we combined physical sensors (pH, soil moisture) with weather forecasting models and AI for predictive release, shifted our bioreactor from continuous operation to a periodic activation model to clear free radicals without over-dosing, adapted our testing to soil environments with strict dosage validation, and refined our wet-lab control groups and electroporation parameters.
blocks.zh: 因此我們把實體感測器（pH、土壤濕度）與天氣預報模型及 AI 結合，做預測性釋放；把生物反應器從連續運轉改為週期性啟動，在不過量的前提下清除自由基；把測試調整到土壤環境並嚴格驗證劑量；也修整了濕式實驗的對照組與電穿孔參數。

blocks.en: Advice
blocks.text: Advice
blocks.zh: 建議

blocks.en: He pointed out that increasing protein secretion is insufficient if the protein loses biological function, advising us to evaluate protein quantity, identity, solubility, and activity holistically. For our plant model, he guided us to establish a clear experimental rationale for heat and salinity stress across agar, hydroponic, and soil systems, while for the dry lab, he suggested using receptor–peptide docking interactions to design shorter constructs that minimize metabolic load while retaining activity.
blocks.text: He pointed out that increasing protein secretion is insufficient if the protein loses biological function, advising us to evaluate protein quantity, identity, solubility, and activity holistically. For our plant model, he guided us to establish a clear experimental rationale for heat and salinity stress across agar, hydroponic, and soil systems, while for the dry lab, he suggested using receptor–peptide docking interactions to design shorter constructs that minimize metabolic load while retaining activity.
blocks.zh: 他指出，如果蛋白質失去生物功能，單純提高分泌量是不夠的，建議我們把蛋白質的量、身分、溶解度與活性整體評估。植物模式方面，他指引我們為瓊脂、水耕與土壤三種系統中的熱逆境與鹽逆境建立清楚的實驗依據；乾式實驗方面，他建議以受體–胜肽的對接交互作用來設計較短的構築，在保留活性的同時把代謝負擔降到最低。

blocks.en: Farmer engagement

blocks.en: As we continued to develop our project, we recognized the importance of incorporating farmers’ perspectives into our development. Through interviews and farm visits, we gained valuable insights into their farming experience, challenges, and concerns. These insights then further reshaped our project and refined our direction to better address the farmers’ needs. Furthermore, based on the farmers’ feedback, we developed platforms that provide them with more accessible information and resources, enabling them to better understand and address the challenges they encounter in their farming practices.

blocks.en: From May to September, we conducted five outreach events, where we interviewed and engaged farmers to verify our assumption of climate stress to plant crops, validated our project idea and evaluated the feasibility of our project in a practical farming scenario. The valuable takeaways gathered from each event gave us a better understanding of farmers’ needs and significantly influenced the development of our project.

blocks.en: On May 16, 2026, our team had the first outreach event at the Taipei Expo Farmers Market. To gain a deeper understanding of the challenges and difficulties faced by farmers, we interviewed over 30 organic, smallholder farmers across Taiwan to learn about their farming experiences and needs. blocks.en: Event summary

blocks.en: On July 21, 2026, Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen invited our team to visit her farm, Tamsui Happy Farm. Unlike traditional farmers, Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen is a natural farming practice farmer who believes we should not give additional support to crops when growing them to help them gain resilience. With Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen’s sharing, we learned about traditional and natural farmers’ perspectives on the application of technology in agriculture. During the visit, we also helped Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen with farming, and we also learned how the plants were affected by stress in different ways.
blocks.text: On July 21, 2026, Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen invited our team to visit her farm, Tamsui Happy Farm. Unlike traditional farmers, Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen is a natural farming practice farmer who believes we should not give additional support to crops when growing them to help them gain resilience. With Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen’s sharing, we learned about traditional and natural farmers’ perspectives on the application of technology in agriculture. During the visit, we also helped Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen with farming, and we also learned how the plants were affected by stress in different ways.
blocks.zh: 2026年7月21日，Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen 邀請我們團隊參訪她的農場淡水幸福農場。與傳統農友不同，Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen 採自然農法，她認為栽培作物時不該額外給予支援，作物才能長出韌性。透過 Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen 的分享，我們了解傳統農友與自然農法農友對於在農業中應用科技的看法。參訪期間我們也幫 Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen 做農事，並看到植物以不同方式受到逆境影響。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: Through the discussion, we learned that farmers might have concerns about the effectiveness of the technology solutions because over-intervention may interfere with natural farming processes, which might unintentionally make it more difficult for these plants to survive in the future by stopping them from adapting to environmental challenges and developing resilience through their own responses. This suggestion then further affects our mathematical model (M1), which aims to represent the conditions of field crops as stress indices and release the appropriate amount of protectant at the right moment. This approach helps prevent excessive or unnecessary protectant production and plant protection, reducing reliance on external inputs and supporting more sustainable farming.
blocks.text: Through the discussion, we learned that farmers might have concerns about the effectiveness of the technology solutions because over-intervention may interfere with natural farming processes, which might unintentionally make it more difficult for these plants to survive in the future by stopping them from adapting to environmental challenges and developing resilience through their own responses. This suggestion then further affects our mathematical model (M1), which aims to represent the conditions of field crops as stress indices and release the appropriate amount of protectant at the right moment. This approach helps prevent excessive or unnecessary protectant production and plant protection, reducing reliance on external inputs and supporting more sustainable farming.
blocks.zh: 透過討論，我們了解農友可能會擔心科技解方的實際效果，因為過度介入可能干擾自然農法的運作，使作物無法透過自身反應去適應環境挑戰、長出韌性，反而在不經意間讓它們未來更難存活。這個建議進一步影響了我們的數學模型（M1），該模型希望把田間作物的狀態表示成逆境指數，並在對的時刻釋放適量的保護劑。這個做法有助於避免過量或不必要的保護劑生產與植物保護，降低對外部投入的依賴，支持更永續的農作。

blocks.en: During the interview, Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen also mentioned that after natural disasters, including typhoons and floods, the seeds of the crops might be lost or destroyed. Therefore, we designed a seed exchange platform that will allow us to track the owners of the seeds.

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: Natural farming farmers’ approach focuses on understanding why problems arise and addressing their underlying causes to restore ecological balance without human interference and support. While natural farming often advocates minimal interference, we recognized that zero intervention in crop protection poses a significant risk: the rate of crop loss due to climate stress often outpaces the natural speed at which plants adapt, escalating the threat of severe food crises. This insight reinforced our goal to provide a balanced solution that supports plant resilience without disrupting nature. In response to this, we develop our mathematical model (M1), which aims to represent the conditions of field crops as stress indices and release the appropriate amount of protectant at the right moment. This approach helps prevent excessive or unnecessary protectant production and plant protection, reducing reliance on external inputs and supporting more sustainable farming.
blocks.text: Natural farming farmers’ approach focuses on understanding why problems arise and addressing their underlying causes to restore ecological balance without human interference and support. While natural farming often advocates minimal interference, we recognized that zero intervention in crop protection poses a significant risk: the rate of crop loss due to climate stress often outpaces the natural speed at which plants adapt, escalating the threat of severe food crises. This insight reinforced our goal to provide a balanced solution that supports plant resilience without disrupting nature. In response to this, we develop our mathematical model (M1), which aims to represent the conditions of field crops as stress indices and release the appropriate amount of protectant at the right moment. This approach helps prevent excessive or unnecessary protectant production and plant protection, reducing reliance on external inputs and supporting more sustainable farming.
blocks.zh: 自然農法農友的做法著重理解問題為什麼發生，並處理其根本原因，在沒有人為干預與支援的情況下恢復生態平衡。雖然自然農法常主張盡量不干預，我們認知到在作物保護上完全不介入有很大的風險：因氣候逆境造成的作物損失速度，往往超過植物自然適應的速度，使嚴重糧食危機的威脅升高。這個認識強化了我們的目標：提供一套平衡的解方，在不破壞自然的前提下支持植物的韌性。為此我們發展了數學模型（M1），該模型希望把田間作物的狀態表示成逆境指數，並在對的時刻釋放適量的保護劑。這個做法有助於避免過量或不必要的保護劑生產與植物保護，降低對外部投入的依賴，支持更永續的農作。

blocks.en: During the forum, the farmers raised questions about the number of bioreactors needed. We responded by developing a detailed analysis in the financial projection of our entrepreneurship wiki. Another farmer raised concerns about whether our solution violates the organic certification rule. By doing deeper research in organic regulation, we confirm our solution can not be applied to organic farms. To better understand these concerns and explore potential solutions, we organized an online interview with Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei (See interview record below), the founder of Lanyang River Friendly Farming Production Cooperative, to gain further insights into farmers’ needs and refine our business plan.

To better understand these concerns and explore potential solutions, we organized an online interview with Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei (See interview record below), the founder of Lanyang River Friendly Farming Production Cooperative, to gain further insights into farmers’ needs and refine our business plan.
blocks.zh: 論壇中，農友對需要多少台生物反應器提出疑問。我們的回應是在創業 wiki 的財務預測中做了詳細分析。另一位農友擔心我們的解方是否違反有機認證規定。經過在有機法規上更深入的研究，我們確認我們的解方無法用於有機農場。為了更了解這些顧慮並尋找可能的解法，我們安排了與 Lanyang River Friendly Farming Production Cooperative 創辦人 Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei 的線上訪談（紀錄見下方），以進一步了解農友的需求並修整商業計畫。

blocks.en: Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei

blocks.en: Event summary
blocks.text: Event summary
blocks.zh: 活動摘要

blocks.en: On September 16, we arranged an online meeting with Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei. After the meeting, we gained a deeper understanding of the challenges the farmers face when adopting technologies similar to ours. One key insight was his concern that our bioreactor could potentially be damaged by natural disasters or wild animals, and that B. subtilis might be intentionally released into the environment.
blocks.text: On September 16, we arranged an online meeting with Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei. After the meeting, we gained a deeper understanding of the challenges the farmers face when adopting technologies similar to ours. One key insight was his concern that our bioreactor could potentially be damaged by natural disasters or wild animals, and that B. subtilis might be intentionally released into the environment.
blocks.zh: 9月16日，我們安排了與 Mr. Chen, Ke-Wei 的線上會談。會後，我們更深入理解農友採用類似我們這種技術時面對的難題。一個關鍵的見解是他的顧慮：我們的生物反應器可能被天災或野生動物破壞，而 B. subtilis 也可能被刻意釋放到環境中。

blocks.en: Impact and adaptation
blocks.text: Impact and adaptation
blocks.zh: 影響與調整

blocks.en: In response, we incorporated this potential risk into the threat analysis of our business plan and reconsidered our approach to biosafety accordingly. More specifically, we consider moving the bioreactor indoors while leaving the sensor outdoors in order to avoid the bioreactor being damaged by animals and natural disaster in manual spray mode.
blocks.text: In response, we incorporated this potential risk into the threat analysis of our business plan and reconsidered our approach to biosafety accordingly. More specifically, we consider moving the bioreactor indoors while leaving the sensor outdoors in order to avoid the bioreactor being damaged by animals and natural disaster in manual spray mode.
blocks.zh: 因此我們把這個潛在風險納入商業計畫的威脅分析，並據此重新思考生物安全的做法。更具體地說，我們考慮在手動噴施模式下把生物反應器移到室內、感測器留在室外，以避免生物反應器被動物與天災破壞。

blocks.en: Additionally, he emphasized that different crops have different needs and levels of capability to environmental stress. Some crops may benefit more from our bioreactor, while others may require little or no intervention, such as strawberries. Based on this feedback, he encouraged us to develop a more targeted marketing strategy focused on specific crop groups.
blocks.text: Additionally, he emphasized that different crops have different needs and levels of capability to environmental stress. Some crops may benefit more from our bioreactor, while others may require little or no intervention, such as strawberries. Based on this feedback, he encouraged us to develop a more targeted marketing strategy focused on specific crop groups.
blocks.zh: 此外，他強調不同作物有不同的需求，承受環境逆境的能力也不同。有些作物可能從我們的生物反應器獲益較多，有些則幾乎不需要介入，例如草莓。依這個回饋，他鼓勵我們針對特定作物群研擬更有針對性的行銷策略。

blocks.en: To improve farmers’ access to practical agricultural information, we developed a LINE platform 「農友助手」, designed to provide agricultural resources through a familiar and easy-to-use interface.
blocks.text: To improve farmers’ access to practical agricultural information, we developed a LINE platform 「農友助手」, designed to provide agricultural resources through a familiar and easy-to-use interface.
blocks.zh: 為了改善農友取得實用農業資訊的管道，我們開發了 LINE 平台「農友助手」，透過熟悉、易用的介面提供農業資源。

blocks.en: During our interactions at the Farmer Expo and Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen’s interview, we realized that although there is information all across the internet, including different websites, government pages, and social media, many smallholder farmers are still not familiar with technology, so they can’t access the resources and find a solution to the problems they are facing efficiently and easily.
blocks.text: During our interactions at the Farmer Expo and Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen’s interview, we realized that although there is information all across the internet, including different websites, government pages, and social media, many smallholder farmers are still not familiar with technology, so they can’t access the resources and find a solution to the problems they are facing efficiently and easily.
blocks.zh: 在農民市集的互動與 Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen 的訪談中，我們發現網路上雖然到處都有資訊，包括各種網站、政府頁面與社群媒體，許多小農對科技仍不熟悉，因此無法有效率、輕鬆地取得資源，為面對的問題找到解法。

blocks.en: Since LINE is an app that is widely used in Taiwan, we established an official account to make our resources more accessible to users. By simply clicking the designated icon, users can be directly redirected to the corresponding website.

The Crop Stress Alert section was designed into a dashboard with a weather forecast and biological risk system. The system can predict heat stress for the upcoming days and also suggest that users take action.
blocks.text: From our interviews with the farmers, we noticed that many of them were affected by environmental stress. The Crop Stress Alert section was designed into a dashboard with a weather forecast and biological risk system. The system can predict heat stress for the upcoming days and also suggest that users take action.
blocks.zh: 從農友訪談中，我們注意到許多人受到環境逆境影響。壓力警報區被設計成一個帶有天氣預報與生物風險系統的儀表板。這套系統可以預測未來幾天的熱逆境，也會建議使用者採取行動。

blocks.en: The website is divided into sections based on different regions of Taiwan, including Northern, Central, and Southern Taiwan, allowing users to easily assess heat stress conditions by selecting the region in which their farm is located. Each regional section contains individual blocks representing different cities. Within each block, the heat stress index is displayed on the left, while the biological risk index for crops is presented on the right.

blocks.en: Crop assistant 作物小幫手
blocks.text: Crop assistant 作物小幫手

blocks.en: Crop Assistant is a website designed to support farmers by suggesting appropriate actions based on their reported farming problems and weather conditions.
blocks.text: Crop Assistant is a website designed to support farmers by suggesting appropriate actions based on their reported farming problems and weather conditions.
blocks.zh: 作物小幫手是一個網站，依使用者回報的農作問題與天氣狀況，建議合適的行動。

blocks.en: Users will be required to answer the questions and report their problem in three steps, including selecting or entering the type of crop affected and the region where their crops are grown. They may also enter their specific location, identify the part of the crop currently affected by the issue, such as the leaves, roots, or flowers, and describe the current weather conditions, the symptoms of the crop, the duration of the issue, the impact on the farm, and the presence of any pests. By providing these information about their situation, the website will be able to deliver a more accurate suggestion.
blocks.text: Users will be required to answer the questions and report their problem in three steps, including selecting or entering the type of crop affected and the region where their crops are grown. They may also enter their specific location, identify the part of the crop currently affected by the issue, such as the leaves, roots, or flowers, and describe the current weather conditions, the symptoms of the crop, the duration of the issue, the impact on the farm, and the presence of any pests. By providing these information about their situation, the website will be able to deliver a more accurate suggestion.
blocks.zh: 使用者需要分三個步驟回答問題並回報狀況，包括選擇或輸入受影響的作物種類，以及作物栽培的區域。他們也可以輸入具體位置、指出目前出問題的作物部位（例如葉、根或花），並描述當前的天氣狀況、作物症狀、問題持續的時間、對農場的影響，以及是否有病蟲害。提供這些情況資訊後，網站就能給出更準確的建議。

blocks.en: After completing the questions, the website will explain the causes of the issue and analyze how each factor may affect the crop, providing users with a better understanding of the problem. It will also suggest some possible solutions and prevention to this issue. If users have additional questions after reviewing the analysis, a built-in AI system will be available to provide further explanations and answer their inquiries.

blocks.en: However, as our website is not intended to replace professional agricultural expertise, we recommend that users consult official government resources before taking any action. Relevant government websites and resources will be provided below for users to access easily.

blocks.text: Seed exchange 種子交換平台

blocks.en: During our visit to Tamsui Happy Farm, Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen mentioned that she hosted an event for seed exchange. However, hosting this kind of event is not really efficient since you need to be present in order to exchange seeds with others. Therefore, we came up with the idea of building the seed exchange platform. This platform allows users to post seed demand and supply information, including specific variety details, harvest year, and planting location. The system then matches users based on their seed requirements and availability. Once both parties confirm the proposed exchange, they can contact each other directly to arrange the exchange.

blocks.zh: 參訪淡水幸福農場時，Ms. Chen, Hui-Wen 提到她曾辦過一場種子交換活動。但這種活動辦起來其實不太有效率，因為你必須到現場才能和別人交換種子。因此我們想到建立種子交換平台。這個平台讓使用者張貼種子的需求與供應資訊，包括具體品種細節、採收年份與種植地點。系統接著依使用者的種子需求與可供量進行配對。雙方確認交換方案後，就可以直接聯絡彼此安排交換。

blocks.en: Through this platform, users can exchange seeds with different farmers and gain access to a wider diversity of seed varieties, including unique or locally adapted varieties that may not be available elsewhere. For example, exchanging seeds with natural farming farmers such as Ms. Chen may provide users with access to seeds that have greater resilience to environmental stresses.

blocks.zh: 透過這個平台，使用者可以和不同農友交換種子，接觸到更多樣的種子品種，包括別處可能找不到的特殊或在地適應品種。例如，與 Ms. Chen 這樣的自然農法農友交換種子，可能讓使用者取得對環境逆境更有韌性的種子。

By entering keywords related to farming issues, such as salinity, heat stress, or pests, users can receive relevant information and suggestions for addressing these problems.

blocks.en: Public engagement
blocks.text: Public engagement
blocks.zh: 公眾互動

blocks.en: On September 5, 2026, our team organized an event at Taipei Water Garden Organic Farmers’ Market. Themed “Taiwan Coffee × Cocoa Gelato Festival,” the event attracted over 400 visitors. To engage both farmers and the public, we hosted a range of different interactive activities, including a public forum, booth activities, and a plant stress event. Through these activities, we raised awareness among participants of the environmental stresses affecting crops and introduced our project and its potential applications in addressing these challenges. By calculating the registration, we successfully engaged over 200 participants throughout the day.

blocks.zh: 2026年9月5日，團隊在臺北水花園有機農學市集辦了一場活動。活動以「臺灣咖啡 × 可可義式冰淇淋節」為主題，吸引超過 400 位來訪者。為了同時接觸農友與一般民眾，我們舉辦了多種互動活動，包括公眾論壇、攤位活動與植物逆境活動。透過這些活動，我們讓參與者認識影響作物的環境逆境，並介紹我們的專案與它處理這些挑戰的可能應用。依報到人數計算，當天我們成功接觸超過 200 位參與者。

blocks.en: Public forum
blocks.text: Public forum
blocks.zh: 公眾論壇

blocks.en: During the morning, we co-hosted a public forum “Field Dialogue: Agricultural Solutions to Climate Change” with Green Media, invited experts, farmers, and the general public to gain a better understanding of farming practices, plant stress, and technology application on the farm. The event successfully engaged more than 50 participants, helping raise public awareness of the challenges faced by farmers and the impacts of environmental stress on agriculture.
blocks.text: During the morning, we co-hosted a public forum “Field Dialogue: Agricultural Solutions to Climate Change” with Green Media, invited experts, farmers, and the general public to gain a better understanding of farming practices, plant stress, and technology application on the farm. The event successfully engaged more than 50 participants, helping raise public awareness of the challenges faced by farmers and the impacts of environmental stress on agriculture.
blocks.zh: 上午我們與 Green Media 共同主辦公眾論壇「田間對話：氣候變遷的農業解方」，邀請專家、農友與一般民眾前來，以更了解農作實務、植物逆境與科技在農場上的應用。活動成功吸引超過 50 位參與者，有助於提升公眾對農友所面臨難題，以及環境逆境對農業影響的認識。

blocks.en: During the meeting with Green Media in early July, we learned that stakeholders from different backgrounds may hold different perspectives on farming, and many farmers may face challenges that we had not anticipated. To provide participants with opportunities to share their research, experiences, and perspectives, we structured the forum to ensure that every participant’s voice could be heard. In this way, we can encourage meaningful exchange among the participants while allowing everyone to gain valuable insights from different perspectives.
blocks.text: During the meeting with Green Media in early July, we learned that stakeholders from different backgrounds may hold different perspectives on farming, and many farmers may face challenges that we had not anticipated. To provide participants with opportunities to share their research, experiences, and perspectives, we structured the forum to ensure that every participant’s voice could be heard. In this way, we can encourage meaningful exchange among the participants while allowing everyone to gain valuable insights from different perspectives.
blocks.zh: 七月初與 Green Media 會談時，我們了解到不同背景的利害關係人對農業可能有不同的看法，許多農友面臨的難題也可能是我們沒有預想到的。為了讓參與者有機會分享自己的研究、經驗與觀點，我們把論壇的形式設計成能讓每位參與者的聲音都被聽見。這樣可以鼓勵參與者之間有意義的交流，也讓每個人都能從不同觀點得到寶貴的見解。

blocks.en: Experts sharing
blocks.text: Experts sharing
blocks.zh: 專家分享

blocks.en: In the first section, we’ve invited experts to share their research and their experiences in farming with the other participants, including Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang, Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying, and an expert from CH Biotech.
blocks.text: In the first section, we’ve invited experts to share their research and their experiences in farming with the other participants, including Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang, Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying, and an expert from CH Biotech.
blocks.zh: 第一段我們邀請專家向其他參與者分享他們的研究與農作經驗，包括 Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang、Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying，以及一位來自 CH Biotech 的專家。

blocks.en: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying
blocks.text: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying

blocks.en: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying emphasized that excessive technology intervention may address symptoms without solving their underlying causes, and compared it to the overuse of painkillers in medicine.
blocks.text: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying emphasized that excessive technology intervention may address symptoms without solving their underlying causes, and compared it to the overuse of painkillers in medicine.
blocks.zh: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying 強調，過度的科技介入可能只處理症狀而沒有解決根本原因，他把這比作醫學上止痛藥的濫用。

blocks.en: When a patient experiences a headache, most doctors may immediately prescribe painkillers to relieve the symptoms, while rarely examining the patient’s lifestyle or addressing the underlying problems causing the condition.
blocks.text: When a patient experiences a headache, most doctors may immediately prescribe painkillers to relieve the symptoms, while rarely examining the patient’s lifestyle or addressing the underlying problems causing the condition.
blocks.zh: 當病人頭痛時，大多數醫師可能立刻開止痛藥來緩解症狀，卻很少檢視病人的生活方式，或處理造成這個狀況的根本問題。

blocks.en: He used the example of Zambia to illustrate how external support and high-yield seeds can reduce farmers’ independence, while natural farming practices using locally adapted seeds and fewer external inputs may support more sustainable farming.
blocks.text: He used the example of Zambia to illustrate how external support and high-yield seeds can reduce farmers’ independence, while natural farming practices using locally adapted seeds and fewer external inputs may support more sustainable farming.
blocks.zh: 他以尚比亞為例，說明外部支援與高產種子如何降低農友的自主性，而使用在地適應品種、較少外部投入的自然農法，則可能支持更永續的農作。

blocks.en: Based on Dr. Li’s sharing, we incorporate this idea into our mathematical model (M1), which aims to represent the conditions of field crops as stress indices and release the appropriate amount of protectant at the right moment. This approach helps prevent excessive or unnecessary protectant production and plant protection, reducing reliance on external inputs and supporting more sustainable farming. In this way, our model reflects Dr. Li’s idea that technology should address the underlying problem rather than relieve symptoms completely.
blocks.text: Based on Dr. Li’s sharing, we incorporate this idea into our mathematical model (M1), which aims to represent the conditions of field crops as stress indices and release the appropriate amount of protectant at the right moment. This approach helps prevent excessive or unnecessary protectant production and plant protection, reducing reliance on external inputs and supporting more sustainable farming. In this way, our model reflects Dr. Li’s idea that technology should address the underlying problem rather than relieve symptoms completely.
blocks.zh: 依 Dr. Li 的分享，我們把這個想法納入數學模型（M1），該模型希望把田間作物的狀態表示成逆境指數，並在對的時刻釋放適量的保護劑。這個做法有助於避免過量或不必要的保護劑生產與植物保護，降低對外部投入的依賴，支持更永續的農作。這樣一來，我們的模型反映了 Dr. Li 的想法：科技應該處理根本問題，而不是把症狀完全壓下去。

blocks.en: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang
blocks.text: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang

blocks.en: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang highlighted that the purpose of smart agriculture is not simply to introduce technology into farming, but to combine IoT sensors and AI models to integrate farmers’ experience into data and provide early warning of potential risks. Furthermore, we developed the software system, digital twin, to help the bioreactor run for weeks with minimal manual instruction, automated control, and risk evaluation.
blocks.text: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang highlighted that the purpose of smart agriculture is not simply to introduce technology into farming, but to combine IoT sensors and AI models to integrate farmers’ experience into data and provide early warning of potential risks. Furthermore, we developed the software system, digital twin, to help the bioreactor run for weeks with minimal manual instruction, automated control, and risk evaluation.
blocks.zh: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang 指出，智慧農業的目的不只是把科技帶進農業，而是結合物聯網感測器與 AI 模型，把農友的經驗轉化成數據，並對潛在風險提早預警。此外，我們開發了軟體系統數位孿生，讓生物反應器可以在極少人工指令下連續運轉數週，並具備自動控制與風險評估。

blocks.en: CH Biotech
blocks.text: CH Biotech

blocks.en: From an industry angle, the expert from CH Biotech shared that agricultural waste, such as feathers, can be used to produce signal peptides as biostimulants, which can help crops maintain energy metabolism under stresses, including typhoons and high temperatures, without increasing fertilizer or pesticide use. His insights inspire us the idea that sustainability should be considered not only in what our project produces but also in the process of producing it. We realized that to evaluate our project’s success, we should consider the overall environmental impact beyond the effectiveness of crop protection. This then led us to develop the idea of using agricultural waste as a growing medium for bacterial culturing, potentially reducing the environmental burden caused by using chemical medium.
blocks.text: From an industry angle, the expert from CH Biotech shared that agricultural waste, such as feathers, can be used to produce signal peptides as biostimulants, which can help crops maintain energy metabolism under stresses, including typhoons and high temperatures, without increasing fertilizer or pesticide use. His insights inspire us the idea that sustainability should be considered not only in what our project produces but also in the process of producing it. We realized that to evaluate our project’s success, we should consider the overall environmental impact beyond the effectiveness of crop protection. This then led us to develop the idea of using agricultural waste as a growing medium for bacterial culturing, potentially reducing the environmental burden caused by using chemical medium.
blocks.zh: 從產業角度，CH Biotech 的專家分享農業廢棄物（例如羽毛）可以用來生產作為生物刺激素的訊號胜肽，能幫助作物在颱風、高溫等逆境下維持能量代謝，而不必增加肥料或農藥的用量。他的見解啟發我們：永續不只要看專案產出什麼，也要看生產的過程。我們意識到要評估專案是否成功，除了作物保護的效果之外，也應該考慮整體的環境影響。這後來引導我們發展出以農業廢棄物作為細菌培養基的想法，可能減少使用化學培養基造成的環境負擔。

blocks.en: Experts feedback
blocks.text: Experts feedback
blocks.zh: 專家回饋

blocks.en: After the experts shared their research and experience, we received valuable feedback on our project and bioreactor design. Their insights helped us to further improve our design.
blocks.text: After the experts shared their research and experience, we received valuable feedback on our project and bioreactor design. Their insights helped us to further improve our design.
blocks.zh: 專家分享研究與經驗之後，我們收到對專案與生物反應器設計的寶貴回饋。他們的見解協助我們進一步改進設計。

blocks.en: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying
blocks.text: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying

blocks.en: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying encouraged us to rethink conventional agricultural practices from a natural farming perspective. He emphasized that rather than directly intervening in plants to improve their growth or resistance, creating an environment that allows plants to develop their own resilience to changing climatic conditions is important.
blocks.text: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying encouraged us to rethink conventional agricultural practices from a natural farming perspective. He emphasized that rather than directly intervening in plants to improve their growth or resistance, creating an environment that allows plants to develop their own resilience to changing climatic conditions is important.
blocks.zh: Dr. Li, Hsu-Ying 鼓勵我們從自然農法的角度重新思考慣行的農業做法。他強調，比起直接介入植物以改善其生長或抗性，更重要的是創造一個能讓植物自己長出韌性、以應對變化中的氣候條件的環境。

blocks.en: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang
blocks.text: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang

blocks.en: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang introduced the engineering perspective of smart agriculture, focusing on how technology can be used to create a more favorable environment for plant growth. Prof. Chen also emphasized the importance of maintaining a balance between intervention and natural plant resilience and suggested that protective measures should be applied based on whether plants can continue growing under specific stress conditions. This perspective highlighted the importance of humane interactions with plants and the environment rather than excessive intervention.
blocks.text: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang introduced the engineering perspective of smart agriculture, focusing on how technology can be used to create a more favorable environment for plant growth. Prof. Chen also emphasized the importance of maintaining a balance between intervention and natural plant resilience and suggested that protective measures should be applied based on whether plants can continue growing under specific stress conditions. This perspective highlighted the importance of humane interactions with plants and the environment rather than excessive intervention.
blocks.zh: Prof. Chen, Wen-Liang 介紹了智慧農業的工程觀點，聚焦科技如何用來為植物生長創造更有利的環境。Prof. Chen 也強調在介入與植物自然韌性之間維持平衡的重要性，並建議保護措施應依植物在特定逆境條件下是否還能繼續生長來施用。這個觀點凸顯了與植物和環境之間人性化互動的重要，而非過度介入。

blocks.en: CH Biotech
blocks.text: CH Biotech

blocks.en: From CH Biotech, we learned the potential applications of bioprotectants in agriculture. The expert introduced us to a key concept: plant metabolism and homeostasis. He stated that rather than simply maximizing plant growth or continuously increasing protection, the goal should be to find a balance between growth and defense.
blocks.text: From CH Biotech, we learned the potential applications of bioprotectants in agriculture. The expert introduced us to a key concept: plant metabolism and homeostasis. He stated that rather than simply maximizing plant growth or continuously increasing protection, the goal should be to find a balance between growth and defense.
blocks.zh: 從 CH Biotech，我們了解生物保護劑在農業中的可能應用。那位專家向我們介紹一個關鍵概念：植物代謝與恆定性。他表示，目標不應該只是把植物生長最大化，或不斷加強保護，而是要在生長與防禦之間找到平衡。

blocks.en: All three answers turn on the same question, how much to intervene, and that is the question our design had to settle: the bioreactor makes protectant only when the sensors read stress, so a crop is carried through a stress episode and left to its own resilience between them.
blocks.text: All three answers turn on the same question, how much to intervene, and that is the question our design had to settle: the bioreactor makes protectant only when the sensors read stress, so a crop is carried through a stress episode and left to its own resilience between them.
blocks.zh: 這三個答案都圍繞同一個問題：該介入到什麼程度。而這正是我們的設計必須解決的問題：生物反應器只在感測器讀到逆境時才製造保護劑，讓作物撐過一次逆境事件，而在兩次之間交給它自己的韌性。

blocks.en: GEMS Taiwan project sharing
blocks.text: GEMS Taiwan project sharing
blocks.zh: GEMS Taiwan 專案分享

blocks.en: After the experts’ sharing, we introduced our project and our bioreactor solution to the participants, which also allowed us to further promote our project and create more impact. During this section, we explained how the bioreactor and the protectant work with an application explanation, allowing the farmers to become more familiar with technology application in the field.
blocks.text: After the experts’ sharing, we introduced our project and our bioreactor solution to the participants, which also allowed us to further promote our project and create more impact. During this section, we explained how the bioreactor and the protectant work with an application explanation, allowing the farmers to become more familiar with technology application in the field.
blocks.zh: 專家分享之後，我們向參與者介紹我們的專案與生物反應器解方，這也讓我們進一步推廣專案、創造更多影響。在這一段，我們以應用說明的方式解釋生物反應器與保護劑如何運作，讓農友更熟悉科技在田間的應用。

blocks.en: Farmers’ feedback
blocks.text: Farmers’ feedback
blocks.zh: 農友回饋

blocks.en: At the end of the event, we arranged a section for the farmers to share their experience in farming and feedback based on what the experts and our team shared. In addition to sharing their experiences, farmers were also allowed to raise questions about challenges they face in farming, specifically those related to environmental stress. Through discussions and exchanges among participants, farmers could gain a better understanding of the causes and impacts of environmental stress on farming, while also learning from the perspectives and expertise of other participants.

Through discussions and exchanges among participants, farmers could gain a better understanding of the causes and impacts of environmental stress on farming, while also learning from the perspectives and expertise of other participants.
blocks.zh: 活動最後，我們安排了一段讓農友分享農作經驗、並依專家和我們團隊分享內容提出回饋的時間。除了分享經驗，農友也可以提出他們在農作中遇到的難題，特別是與環境逆境相關的問題。透過參與者之間的討論與交流，農友能更了解環境逆境對農作的成因與影響，也能從其他參與者的觀點與專業中學習。

blocks.en: More specifically, farmers raised two questions during the discussion session. The first concerned whether organic certification is required when using our bioreactor. The second concerned the number of bioreactors needed for use on their farms.
blocks.text: More specifically, farmers raised two questions during the discussion session. The first concerned whether organic certification is required when using our bioreactor. The second concerned the number of bioreactors needed for use on their farms.

blocks.en: After the public forum, our team truly gained valuable insights into different aspects through different speakers and farmers’ advice. To evaluate the impact of this event, we designed a Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices (KAP) survey for the speakers, farmers, and the general public who attended. Each group receives different questions based on their roles in this event.
blocks.text: After the public forum, our team truly gained valuable insights into different aspects through different speakers and farmers’ advice. To evaluate the impact of this event, we designed a Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices (KAP) survey for the speakers, farmers, and the general public who attended. Each group receives different questions based on their roles in this event.

blocks.en: To better engage with the public, we arranged some booth activities to not only raise awareness but also promote our project. In this event, we introduced over 160 visitors to the effects of stress and our bioreactor solution through six booths with different interactive activities.

blocks.en: To keep visitors engaged and excited to explore everything we had to offer, we introduced an interactive stamp card system. Participants collected a stamp at each booth after completing the activity and answering a few brief questions set by our team. Once they gathered all six stamps and filled out an anonymous feedback survey, they unlocked a small prize of team merch and earned their spot to participate in our popular DIY arts & crafts activity.

blocks.en: Coffee infographic
blocks.text: Coffee infographic

blocks.en: Because this event was in collaboration with Green Media, who happened to be hosting a “Taiwanese Coffee & Cocoa Bean” event, we also decided to take part in this. We created an infographic highlighting the importance of supporting local Taiwanese cocoa farming and explaining how climate change impacts cocoa production. Since coffee and cocoa share similar agricultural challenges, we showed how changing weather patterns affect these crops and why that matters to everyday consumers who rely on them.

blocks.en: ReLEAF project introduction
blocks.text: ReLEAF project introduction
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 專案介紹

blocks.en: Additionally, this event served as an ideal platform to promote ReLEAF and engage the public with the core principles of our synthetic biology project. Our team presented visual posters and communicated complex concepts in clear, accessible terms. To make the science more tangible, we showcased photos tracking the growth progress of our Arabidopsis plants and displayed a prototype of our bioreactor, enabling visitors to visualize the physical outcome and practical application of our design.
blocks.text: Additionally, this event served as an ideal platform to promote ReLEAF and engage the public with the core principles of our synthetic biology project. Our team presented visual posters and communicated complex concepts in clear, accessible terms. To make the science more tangible, we showcased photos tracking the growth progress of our Arabidopsis plants and displayed a prototype of our bioreactor, enabling visitors to visualize the physical outcome and practical application of our design.
blocks.zh: 此外，這場活動也是推廣 ReLEAF、讓公眾接觸我們合成生物學專案核心原理的理想平台。團隊展示視覺海報，並以清楚、易懂的說法傳達複雜概念。為了讓科學更具體，我們展出追蹤 Arabidopsis 生長進度的照片，並陳列生物反應器的原型，讓來訪者能看見設計的實體成果與實際應用。

blocks.en: Data physicalization
blocks.text: Data physicalization
blocks.zh: 數據實體化

blocks.en: In our data physicalization station, we wanted a way to turn abstract data on screens and paper into an experience that allowed people to understand the data through interactive maps and activities. We had two main parts to this booth. First, we set up an activity focused on plant stress, where we played real recordings of plants under drought stress. In this experience visitors were actually able to feel the impact of plant stress firsthand, bringing the concept to life beyond dry scientific data. Second, we created an interactive map that showed the relationship between heat stress and rice crop yields, letting visitors see how rising temperatures directly impact food production, through LED lights and color coded regions.

blocks.zh: 在數據實體化站，我們希望把螢幕與紙本上抽象的數據，轉成一種可以透過互動地圖與活動去理解的體驗。這個攤位有兩個主要部分。第一，我們設置了一個以植物逆境為主題的活動，播放乾旱逆境下植物的實際錄音。在這個體驗中，來訪者真的能親身感受植物逆境的影響，讓這個概念超越乾澀的科學數據而活起來。第二，我們做了一張互動地圖，透過 LED 燈與色彩分區呈現熱逆境與稻米產量之間的關係，讓來訪者看見升溫如何直接影響糧食生產。

blocks.en: Ring toss
blocks.text: Ring toss
blocks.zh: 套圈圈

blocks.en: For our ring toss booth, we wanted to help people understand the difference between biotic and abiotic stress, as well as why different protectants are needed for different types of stress. We turned this concept into an interactive ring toss game where bottles were labeled with various plant stressors, and color-coded rings represented different protectants. Participants had to match the correct ring to the corresponding stressor, making learning about plant protection fun and easy to grasp.
blocks.text: For our ring toss booth, we wanted to help people understand the difference between biotic and abiotic stress, as well as why different protectants are needed for different types of stress. We turned this concept into an interactive ring toss game where bottles were labeled with various plant stressors, and color-coded rings represented different protectants. Participants had to match the correct ring to the corresponding stressor, making learning about plant protection fun and easy to grasp.
blocks.zh: 套圈圈攤位的目的，是幫助大家理解生物性逆境與非生物逆境的差別，以及為什麼不同類型的逆境需要不同的保護劑。我們把這個概念變成互動的套圈圈遊戲：瓶子上標示各種植物逆境因子，不同顏色的圈圈代表不同的保護劑。參與者必須把正確的圈圈套到對應的逆境因子上，讓學習植物保護變得有趣又好懂。

blocks.en: Online game
blocks.text: Online game
blocks.zh: 線上遊戲

blocks.en: To really help enforce concepts of protectants and different environmental stress, we also developed our own interactive online game. As different environmental stressors rained down on the virtual plants, players had to quickly identify the threat and shoot the matching protectant to defend their crop. This fast-paced mechanic made learning how specific protectants counter targeted stressors both engaging and memorable.

blocks.zh: 為了真正強化保護劑與各種環境逆境的概念，我們也自行開發了互動線上遊戲。當不同的環境逆境因子如雨點般落向虛擬植物時，玩家必須快速辨認威脅，並發射對應的保護劑來守護作物。這種快節奏的機制，讓學習特定保護劑如何對應特定逆境因子既有趣又好記。

blocks.en: DIY arts and crafts
blocks.text: DIY arts and crafts
blocks.zh: DIY 手作

blocks.en: In correspondence with our theme of relieving stress, we set up a craft station where visitors could build their own fidget keyboard clicker toys. We also provided handmade, team-themed stickers featuring our project mascot so participants could decorate their clickers, giving them a fun, hands-on way to create their own personalized stress-relief tool to take home.

blocks.en: Survey analysis
blocks.text: Survey analysis
blocks.zh: 問卷分析

blocks.en: To gauge how effective and impactful our afternoon booth activities/games were to the public, we designed a survey based on the Knowledge-Attitude-Practice (KAP) structure. Using this format, we asked questions ranging from how well they retained knowledge from certain booth explanations, to what they were willing to do in the future after learning about current climate events and our project details. Through this survey, we hope to capture a definitive reflection of our project’s ultimate impact, measuring how effectively our final event transformed public awareness into actionable, everyday commitments. By evaluating participant responses across all three KAP dimensions, this closing dataset will allow us to measure the lasting educational value of our booth activities and evaluate how successfully our collective outreach efforts inspired meaningful changes and allowed for even more light to be shone on this global topic.

blocks.en: Overall impact of the booth activities

blocks.en: Our booth event at the Taipei Water Garden Organic Farmers’ Market gave us a great chance to connect our lab work with the general public. Through our six interactive stations, covering coffee farming, plant stress maps, drought sound recordings, ring toss games, an online defense game, and DIY crafts, we were able to explain synthetic biology in a way that felt approachable and easy to understand.
blocks.text: Our booth event at the Taipei Water Garden Organic Farmers’ Market gave us a great chance to connect our lab work with the general public. Through our six interactive stations, covering coffee farming, plant stress maps, drought sound recordings, ring toss games, an online defense game, and DIY crafts, we were able to explain synthetic biology in a way that felt approachable and easy to understand.
blocks.zh: 我們在臺北水花園有機農學市集的攤位活動，給了我們把實驗室工作與一般民眾連起來的好機會。透過六個互動站，涵蓋咖啡種植、植物逆境地圖、乾旱聲音錄音、套圈圈遊戲、線上防禦遊戲與 DIY 手作，我們得以用一種親近、好懂的方式說明合成生物學。

blocks.en: The feedback we collected showed that people really connected with the activities. Over 90% of visitors said they left with a better understanding of plant stress and how ReLEAF works, and more than half remembered specific details like Yilan being a high-stress farming area. Almost everyone had a positive experience at the booth, and 96.8% said they planned to share what they learned with friends and family.

blocks.zh: 我們收集到的回饋顯示，大家確實與這些活動產生連結。超過 90% 的來訪者表示離開時對植物逆境與 ReLEAF 的運作有了更好的理解，超過半數還記得宜蘭是高逆境農業區這類具體細節。幾乎每個人在攤位都有正面的體驗，96.8% 表示打算把學到的東西分享給朋友與家人。

blocks.en: More importantly, talking to visitors gave us real insights that helped refine our project. People were fascinated by the drought sound recordings, which confirmed that using natural plant signals was a great way to explain our biosensors. On the other hand, their questions about soil safety reminded us how important it is to be transparent about our non-harmful, biocontained design. These conversations helped ensure that ReLEAF stays focused on safety, real-world usefulness, and community trust.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.text: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 結論

blocks.en: Summary
blocks.text: Summary
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Through continuous engagement and discussions with stakeholders from farmers to agricultural organizations and companies to professors and experts, ReLEAF was able to grow into a project grounded in practical application, safety, and community trust. These dialogues ensured that our solution addresses actual field challenges that exist in the real-field. Each of these dialogues were incorporated into and directly shaped each of the five pipelines: plants and stress, protectant design, genetic circuits and cloning, bioreactor and modeling, and lastly the deployment of our project onto the real-field. Throughout this iterative process, our team engaged with 31 stakeholders across research, industry, and agriculture, conducting in-depth consultations with academic experts and gathering direct field insights from growers and agricultural representatives.
blocks.text: Through continuous engagement and discussions with stakeholders from farmers to agricultural organizations and companies to professors and experts, ReLEAF was able to grow into a project grounded in practical application, safety, and community trust. These dialogues ensured that our solution addresses actual field challenges that exist in the real-field. Each of these dialogues were incorporated into and directly shaped each of the five pipelines: plants and stress, protectant design, genetic circuits and cloning, bioreactor and modeling, and lastly the deployment of our project onto the real-field. Throughout this iterative process, our team engaged with 31 stakeholders across research, industry, and agriculture, conducting in-depth consultations with academic experts and gathering direct field insights from growers and agricultural representatives.
blocks.zh: 透過與農友、農業組織、企業、教授與專家等各方利害關係人的持續互動與討論，ReLEAF 得以成長為一個立基於實際應用、安全與社群信任的專案。這些對話確保我們的解方處理的是真實田間存在的挑戰。每一次對話都被納入並直接塑造了五條脈絡：植物與逆境、保護劑設計、基因迴路與選殖、生物反應器與建模，最後是把專案帶到真實田間的落地應用。在這個迭代的過程中，團隊與研究、產業與農業界共 31 位利害關係人互動，與學界專家進行深入諮詢，並直接從生產者與農業代表那裡取得田間見解。

blocks.en: Our interactions didn’t just end there; we also held a public forum event and booth activities that attracted more than 200 visitors in total. This event helped spread our project to the community and the public, and allowed us to bridge the gap between our laboratory research and the wider public, fostering open conversations about synthetic biology and sustainable farming practices through interactive games, activities and explanations.
