blocks.en: Our Integrated Human Practices journey played a pivotal role in bridging the gap between theoretical synthetic biology and practical agricultural implementation. By stepping outside the laboratory, we validated our scientific goals against real-world environmental safety standards, regulatory expectations, and everyday farm management routines.
blocks.text: Our Integrated Human Practices journey played a pivotal role in bridging the gap between theoretical synthetic biology and practical agricultural implementation. By stepping outside the laboratory, we validated our scientific goals against real-world environmental safety standards, regulatory expectations, and everyday farm management routines.
blocks.zh: 我們的整合式人類實踐歷程，在拉近理論合成生物學與實際農業落實之間的距離上，扮演了關鍵角色。走出實驗室，讓我們得以用真實世界的環境安全標準、法規期待與日常農場管理流程，來檢驗自己的科學目標。

blocks.en: Answering the judging criteria
blocks.text: Answering the judging criteria
blocks.zh: 回應評審標準

blocks.en: How well was Human Practices work integrated throughout the project?
blocks.text: How well was Human Practices work integrated throughout the project?
blocks.zh: 人類實踐的工作在整個專案中整合得如何？

blocks.en: Human Practices was embedded into ReLEAF from day one, serving as a continuous feedback loop that helped us understand how to improve our project further. Across nine months from February to October, every stakeholder’s insights directly impacted and led to changes in research direction, plant focuses, and hardware designs, ensuring that our technical development was constantly shaped by real-world needs. Rather than viewing these expert consultations as one-off events, we repeatedly updated the stakeholders with new ideas, prototypes, and questions, allowing their feedback to guide our next step.
blocks.text: Human Practices was embedded into ReLEAF from day one, serving as a continuous feedback loop that helped us understand how to improve our project further. Across nine months from February to October, every stakeholder’s insights directly impacted and led to changes in research direction, plant focuses, and hardware designs, ensuring that our technical development was constantly shaped by real-world needs. Rather than viewing these expert consultations as one-off events, we repeatedly updated the stakeholders with new ideas, prototypes, and questions, allowing their feedback to guide our next step.
blocks.zh: 人類實踐從第一天就嵌進 ReLEAF，成為一個持續的回饋迴路，幫助我們理解如何進一步改進專案。從二月到十月的九個月間，每一位利害關係人的見解都直接影響並促成研究方向、植物焦點與硬體設計上的改變，確保技術開發持續受真實需求塑造。我們沒有把這些專家諮詢當成一次性的活動，而是帶著新的想法、原型與問題一再回去更新，讓他們的回饋引導我們的下一步。

blocks.en: For example, on April 10, we had the first meeting with Prof. Chen Wen-Liang, who refined our whole project direction with the idea of a bioreactor system instead of releasing plant growth-promoting bacteria (PGPR) directly into the soil. On June 20, we then arranged another meeting with a prototype for further discussion. We then consulted him again on October 15, during which he advised us to introduce ReLEAF through a practical agricultural scenario and guided us to clarify the connections between our sensors, mathematical model, and bioreactor.

blocks.zh: 舉例來說，4月10日我們與 Prof. Chen Wen-Liang 第一次會面，他以生物反應器系統的構想取代把植物生長促進細菌（PGPR）直接釋放到土壤，修整了我們整個專案方向。6月20日，我們帶著原型再安排一次會面做進一步討論。10月15日我們又向他請益，他建議我們透過實際的農業情境介紹 ReLEAF，並引導我們釐清感測器、數學模型與生物反應器之間的連結。

blocks.en: Similarly, we visited Prof. Cheng Mei-Chun’s lab on March 27 and August 28 for consultation on our plant model, and Prof. Chang Jo-Shu visited our lab to help us recognize the importance of technical performance and usability. These continuous meetings allowed us to refine both our biological and hardware designs as the project developed.

blocks.en: Together, these interactions show that Human Practices was not a separate component outside our experiments, but a continuous process that integrated into our research and design. blocks.en: How thoughtfully was it implemented? How well did they explain the context, rationale, and prior work?

blocks.en: Our outreach directly targeted the specific knowledge gaps and technical challenges we encountered along the way. By examining existing agricultural methods and problems, prior work, and current biotechnology limitations, we framed the clear context for each step of ReLEAF to identify how our solution could help. Every expert interview and field visit had a defined purpose: team members researched our exact roadblocks and identified the ideal expert to consult. This prepared us to ask well-researched questions and integrate feedback with clear rationale, ensuring every interaction was purposeful and focused, the following are some examples of stakeholder engagement that redirected our project in different aspects.

blocks.en: Redesigned our project around a controlled, bioreactor-based system instead of releasing live bacteria into the soil.
blocks.text: Redesigned our project around a controlled, bioreactor-based system instead of releasing live bacteria into the soil.

blocks.en: Using mainly hydroponics proved unstable and made it difficult to isolate stress responses without experimental setups interfering with plant growth.
blocks.text: Using mainly hydroponics proved unstable and made it difficult to isolate stress responses without experimental setups interfering with plant growth.
blocks.zh: 主要使用水耕被證明不夠穩定，也難以在實驗設置不干擾植物生長的情況下，把逆境反應單獨分離出來。

blocks.text: A plant biology specialist who focuses on plant model establishment and stress testing protocols.
blocks.zh: 一位專注於植物模式建立與逆境測試流程的植物生物學專家。

blocks.en: Replaced pure hydroponics with an agar plate-to-soil transition model to ensure stable early growth and realistic stress conditions.
blocks.text: Replaced pure hydroponics with an agar plate-to-soil transition model to ensure stable early growth and realistic stress conditions.
blocks.zh: 以瓊脂培養盤到土壤的轉移模式取代純水耕，確保早期生長穩定，逆境條件也更接近真實。

blocks.en: To what extent did they convince you that their Human Practices activities helped create a project that is responsible and good for the world?
blocks.text: To what extent did they convince you that their Human Practices activities helped create a project that is responsible and good for the world?
blocks.zh: 他們在多大程度上讓你相信，其人類實踐工作協助打造出一個負責任、對世界有益的專案？

blocks.en: Throughout our project, the question of how we could design a solution that was safe and helpful remained in our minds. To achieve this, we engaged in interviews and meetings with several stakeholders, including farmers, biosafety experts, and plant biologists, which helped ensure that ReLEAF was designed with safety, ethics, and environmental considerations at its core.
blocks.text: Throughout our project, the question of how we could design a solution that was safe and helpful remained in our minds. To achieve this, we engaged in interviews and meetings with several stakeholders, including farmers, biosafety experts, and plant biologists, which helped ensure that ReLEAF was designed with safety, ethics, and environmental considerations at its core.
blocks.zh: 整個專案期間，我們心裡一直有一個問題：如何設計出一個既安全又有幫助的解方。為此我們與多方利害關係人進行訪談與會面，包括農友、生物安全專家與植物生物學家，這有助於確保 ReLEAF 的設計把安全、倫理與環境考量放在核心。

blocks.en: First, we were challenged on whether external intervention could undermine plants’ natural resilience. Both Ms. Chen Hui-Wen and Dr. Li Hsu-Ying questioned whether providing external support might only address the symptoms without addressing the underlying causes, which might potentially make crops dependent on technological intervention. The farmers’ feedback helped us understand that success is not just simply about maximizing plant growth, but also providing appropriate support when crops need it.
blocks.text: First, we were challenged on whether external intervention could undermine plants’ natural resilience. Both Ms. Chen Hui-Wen and Dr. Li Hsu-Ying questioned whether providing external support might only address the symptoms without addressing the underlying causes, which might potentially make crops dependent on technological intervention. The farmers’ feedback helped us understand that success is not just simply about maximizing plant growth, but also providing appropriate support when crops need it.
blocks.zh: 首先，我們被質疑外部介入是否會削弱植物的自然韌性。Ms. Chen Hui-Wen 與 Dr. Li Hsu-Ying 都質疑提供外部支援是否只處理症狀而沒有處理根本原因，並可能讓作物依賴技術介入。農友的回饋讓我們理解，成功不只是把植物生長最大化，而是在作物需要時提供適當的支援。

blocks.en: Second, we reconsidered the physical safety of our system. During the meeting with Mr. Chen Ke-Wei, he raised a concern about what would happen if an animal damaged the device or a typhoon destroyed it. This then inspired us to incorporate physical damage and extreme weather into our threat analysis and made the decision to move the bioreactor indoors.
blocks.text: Second, we reconsidered the physical safety of our system. During the meeting with Mr. Chen Ke-Wei, he raised a concern about what would happen if an animal damaged the device or a typhoon destroyed it. This then inspired us to incorporate physical damage and extreme weather into our threat analysis and made the decision to move the bioreactor indoors.
blocks.zh: 其次，我們重新思考系統的實體安全。與 Mr. Chen Ke-Wei 會談時，他提出一個顧慮：如果動物弄壞了裝置，或颱風把它摧毀了，會怎麼樣？這啟發我們把實體損壞與極端天氣納入威脅分析，並決定把生物反應器移到室內。

blocks.en: Finally, our engagement with farmers revealed the conflict between our solution and the existing regulations. Many of the farmers we interviewed were organic or friendly farming practices farmers. However, as ReLEAF uses genetically modified microorganisms, it may not comply with Taiwan’s organic production regulations. This exposed a gap between our original vision of helping farmers and the potential stakeholders that could adopt our system. It showed us that a technical solution is not automatically an appropriate one for every region.
blocks.text: Finally, our engagement with farmers revealed the conflict between our solution and the existing regulations. Many of the farmers we interviewed were organic or friendly farming practices farmers. However, as ReLEAF uses genetically modified microorganisms, it may not comply with Taiwan’s organic production regulations. This exposed a gap between our original vision of helping farmers and the potential stakeholders that could adopt our system. It showed us that a technical solution is not automatically an appropriate one for every region.
blocks.zh: 最後，與農友的互動揭露了我們的解方與現行法規之間的衝突。我們訪談的農友中有許多是有機或友善耕作的農友。然而，由於 ReLEAF 使用基因改造微生物，可能不符合臺灣的有機農產品生產規範。這暴露出我們原本「幫助農友」的願景，與可能採用我們系統的利害關係人之間存在落差。它讓我們看到，一個技術上的解方並不自動就是每個地區的合適解方。

blocks.en: These criticisms changed how we evaluate ReLEAF’s potential impact. Human Practices did not simply convince us that our project was impactful for the world, but challenged us to examine whom it could benefit, what risks it might introduce, and whether its intervention was justified in the first place. We see responsibility as a continuous process of testing our assumptions, acknowledging limitations, and adapting our design to real-world needs.
blocks.text: These criticisms changed how we evaluate ReLEAF’s potential impact. Human Practices did not simply convince us that our project was impactful for the world, but challenged us to examine whom it could benefit, what risks it might introduce, and whether its intervention was justified in the first place. We see responsibility as a continuous process of testing our assumptions, acknowledging limitations, and adapting our design to real-world needs.
blocks.zh: 這些批評改變了我們評估 ReLEAF 潛在影響的方式。人類實踐並不是單純說服我們專案對世界有影響力，而是要求我們檢視：它可能讓誰受益、可能帶來什麼風險，以及它的介入一開始是否站得住腳。我們把責任視為一個持續的過程：檢驗自己的假設、承認限制，並依真實世界的需求調整設計。

blocks.en: How well did it incorporate different stakeholder views?
blocks.text: How well did it incorporate different stakeholder views?
blocks.zh: 納入不同利害關係人觀點的程度如何？

blocks.en: Together, we gathered perspectives across a broad spectrum of 31 stakeholders across five distinct domains: deployment, plant and stress biology, protectant design, gene circuit and cloning, bioreactor and hardware. Combining these technical insights with the lived experiences of local farmers and public feedback allowed us to balance high-level scientific rigor with practical usability in the field.
blocks.text: Together, we gathered perspectives across a broad spectrum of 31 stakeholders across five distinct domains: deployment, plant and stress biology, protectant design, gene circuit and cloning, bioreactor and hardware. Combining these technical insights with the lived experiences of local farmers and public feedback allowed us to balance high-level scientific rigor with practical usability in the field.
blocks.zh: 我們一起從五個不同領域、共 31 位利害關係人那裡收集觀點：落地應用、植物與逆境生物學、保護劑設計、基因迴路與選殖、生物反應器與硬體。把這些技術見解和在地農友的親身經驗以及公眾回饋結合起來，讓我們能在高水準的科學嚴謹與田間的實際可用性之間取得平衡。

blocks.en: For example, meeting up with Ms. Chen Hui-Wen opened our perspective to the world of natural farming. During this meeting, we learned about the importance of precise stress prediction and targeted application to prevent the overuse of protectants, which can inadvertently reduce crop resilience. While natural farming often advocates minimal interference, we recognized that zero intervention in crop protection poses a significant risk: the rate of crop loss due to climate stress often outpaces the natural speed at which plants adapt, escalating the threat of severe food crises. This insight reinforced our goal to provide a balanced solution that supports plant resilience without disrupting nature.
blocks.text: For example, meeting up with Ms. Chen Hui-Wen opened our perspective to the world of natural farming. During this meeting, we learned about the importance of precise stress prediction and targeted application to prevent the overuse of protectants, which can inadvertently reduce crop resilience. While natural farming often advocates minimal interference, we recognized that zero intervention in crop protection poses a significant risk: the rate of crop loss due to climate stress often outpaces the natural speed at which plants adapt, escalating the threat of severe food crises. This insight reinforced our goal to provide a balanced solution that supports plant resilience without disrupting nature.
blocks.zh: 舉例來說，與 Ms. Chen Hui-Wen 的會面打開了我們對自然農法世界的視野。這次會面中，我們了解精準預測逆境與針對性施用的重要，以避免過度使用保護劑、反而在不經意間降低作物的韌性。雖然自然農法常主張盡量不干預，我們認知到在作物保護上完全不介入有很大的風險：因氣候逆境造成的作物損失速度，往往超過植物自然適應的速度，使嚴重糧食危機的威脅升高。這個認識強化了我們的目標：提供一套平衡的解方，在不破壞自然的前提下支持植物的韌性。

blocks.en: Meeting up with Prof. Chen Wen-Liang shifted our focus to smart farming. He advised us to build a controlled bioreactor system where the hardware acts as a “printer” and the bacteria as the “ink.” Originally, we planned to release bacteria directly into the soil. However, we realized this posed biosafety risks and that a purely local approach limited our reach. As a result, we switched to a contained bioreactor system.
blocks.text: Meeting up with Prof. Chen Wen-Liang shifted our focus to smart farming. He advised us to build a controlled bioreactor system where the hardware acts as a “printer” and the bacteria as the “ink.” Originally, we planned to release bacteria directly into the soil. However, we realized this posed biosafety risks and that a purely local approach limited our reach. As a result, we switched to a contained bioreactor system.
blocks.zh: 與 Prof. Chen Wen-Liang 的會面把我們的焦點轉向智慧農業。他建議我們建立一套受控的生物反應器系統，硬體扮演「印表機」，細菌扮演「墨水」。我們原本計畫把細菌直接釋放到土壤，但後來意識到這有生物安全風險，而純粹在地的做法也限制了觸及範圍。因此我們改採圍阻式的生物反應器系統。

blocks.en: To what extent is the Human Practices work documented so that others can build upon it?
blocks.text: To what extent is the Human Practices work documented so that others can build upon it?
blocks.zh: 人類實踐的工作被記錄到什麼程度，足以讓他人在其上繼續發展？

blocks.en: To ensure our Human Practices framework is completely reproducible, we have structured and open-sourced three complete, downloadable resource packages so future teams can easily adapt and extend our work. First, a clear survey structure, separated into three main domains: Knowledge, Attitude, and Practice (KAP) that efficiently captures the effects and results of our events across farmers, domain experts, and the general public; second, standardized interview question sets categorized across plant biology, protectant design, hardware engineering, and deployment domains to streamline qualitative stakeholder research; and third, our “農友助手” (Farmer’s Assistant) LINE platform, which provides an automatic bot reply that other teams can also use in the future.
blocks.text: To ensure our Human Practices framework is completely reproducible, we have structured and open-sourced three complete, downloadable resource packages so future teams can easily adapt and extend our work. First, a clear survey structure, separated into three main domains: Knowledge, Attitude, and Practice (KAP) that efficiently captures the effects and results of our events across farmers, domain experts, and the general public; second, standardized interview question sets categorized across plant biology, protectant design, hardware engineering, and deployment domains to streamline qualitative stakeholder research; and third, our “農友助手” (Farmer’s Assistant) LINE platform, which provides an automatic bot reply that other teams can also use in the future.
blocks.zh: 為了讓我們的人類實踐架構完全可重現，我們整理並開源了三套完整、可下載的資源包，讓未來的隊伍能輕鬆沿用與擴充我們的工作。第一，一套清楚的問卷結構，分成知識、態度與行為（KAP）三大面向，能有效捕捉我們的活動在農友、領域專家與一般民眾身上產生的效果與結果；第二，一套標準化的訪談題組，依植物生物學、保護劑設計、硬體工程與落地應用等領域分類，讓質性的利害關係人研究更順暢；第三，我們的「農友助手」（Farmer's Assistant）LINE 平台，提供自動機器人回覆，其他隊伍未來也可以使用。

blocks.en: How inspiring an example is it to others?
blocks.text: How inspiring an example is it to others?
blocks.zh: 對其他人來說，這是多有啟發性的範例？

blocks.en: ReLEAF demonstrates how synthetic biology can move beyond abstract lab research to tackle urgent global challenges like climate change and food security, and integrate Human Practices into project development. Throughout our project, we developed several approaches that other teams can adapt to their own contexts.
blocks.text: ReLEAF demonstrates how synthetic biology can move beyond abstract lab research to tackle urgent global challenges like climate change and food security, and integrate Human Practices into project development. Throughout our project, we developed several approaches that other teams can adapt to their own contexts.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 展示了合成生物學如何走出抽象的實驗室研究，去面對氣候變遷與糧食安全這類急迫的全球挑戰，並把人類實踐整合進專案開發。整個專案期間，我們發展出幾種其他隊伍可以依自身脈絡沿用的做法。

blocks.en: First, our five-pipeline structure organized stakeholder engagement across plant and stress biology, protectant design, gene circuits and cloning, bioreactor and hardware, and deployment and Human Practices. By connecting expert feedback to specific design decisions and actions, we translated insights gained from our meetings into changes that shaped the project’s evolution.
blocks.text: First, our five-pipeline structure organized stakeholder engagement across plant and stress biology, protectant design, gene circuits and cloning, bioreactor and hardware, and deployment and Human Practices. By connecting expert feedback to specific design decisions and actions, we translated insights gained from our meetings into changes that shaped the project’s evolution.
blocks.zh: 第一，我們的五脈絡結構把利害關係人互動分別組織到植物與逆境生物學、保護劑設計、基因迴路與選殖、生物反應器與硬體，以及落地應用與人類實踐之下。把專家回饋連到具體的設計決策與行動，我們把會面中得到的見解轉成塑造專案演進的改變。

blocks.en: Second, we co-hosted and organized a public forum with a media partner, Green Media, creating opportunities to engage with farmers and the general public beyond our existing networks. Through this event, we connected with people from different regions and farming backgrounds whom we might not have encountered through expert interviews. Their perspectives broadened our understanding of the diverse challenges farmers face. In the future, we could connect with the government and local agricultural research and extension stations to connect with farmers across different regions, ensuring that we can gain more diverse perspectives to inform our decisions and further refine our design and implementation.
blocks.text: Second, we co-hosted and organized a public forum with a media partner, Green Media, creating opportunities to engage with farmers and the general public beyond our existing networks. Through this event, we connected with people from different regions and farming backgrounds whom we might not have encountered through expert interviews. Their perspectives broadened our understanding of the diverse challenges farmers face. In the future, we could connect with the government and local agricultural research and extension stations to connect with farmers across different regions, ensuring that we can gain more diverse perspectives to inform our decisions and further refine our design and implementation.
blocks.zh: 第二，我們與媒體夥伴 Green Media 共同主辦並籌辦了一場公眾論壇，創造出在既有人際網絡之外與農友和一般民眾互動的機會。透過這場活動，我們接觸到來自不同區域、不同農作背景的人，這些人我們可能無法透過專家訪談遇到。他們的觀點拓寬了我們對農友所面臨多元難題的理解。未來我們可以與政府及地方的農業改良場合作，接觸不同區域的農友，以取得更多元的觀點來支持決策，並進一步修整設計與落實。

blocks.en: Lastly, we used farmers’ markets as interview sites, allowing us to engage directly with farmers to gain their feedback. This made stakeholder engagement more accessible and helped us understand farmers’ concerns beyond the laboratory. However, farmers who attend these markets may not represent all the agricultural communities. In the future, we could combine more market-based interviews to reach a broader range of voices.
blocks.text: Lastly, we used farmers’ markets as interview sites, allowing us to engage directly with farmers to gain their feedback. This made stakeholder engagement more accessible and helped us understand farmers’ concerns beyond the laboratory. However, farmers who attend these markets may not represent all the agricultural communities. In the future, we could combine more market-based interviews to reach a broader range of voices.
blocks.zh: 最後，我們把農民市集當成訪談場地，讓我們能直接與農友互動、取得他們的回饋。這讓利害關係人互動更容易進行，也幫助我們在實驗室之外理解農友的顧慮。不過，會參加這些市集的農友可能無法代表所有的農業社群。未來我們可以結合更多以市集為基礎的訪談，以觸及更廣泛的聲音。

blocks.en: These experiences taught us that Human Practices require a way to connect feedback to decisions and a willingness to recognize the gaps and criticism. By sharing our experiences and limitations that we encountered, we hope ReLEAF can offer future teams a practical starting point for building projects that are not only scientifically ambitious, but also responsive to the people and the environment.
blocks.text: These experiences taught us that Human Practices require a way to connect feedback to decisions and a willingness to recognize the gaps and criticism. By sharing our experiences and limitations that we encountered, we hope ReLEAF can offer future teams a practical starting point for building projects that are not only scientifically ambitious, but also responsive to the people and the environment.
blocks.zh: 這些經驗教會我們：人類實踐需要一套把回饋連到決策的方法，也需要願意承認缺口與批評。透過分享我們的經驗與遇到的限制，我們希望 ReLEAF 能為未來的隊伍提供一個實用的起點，讓他們建立的專案不只在科學上有企圖心，也能回應人與環境。
